jobs.title: Web Dev Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join Our Dynamic Team as a Web Development Project Manager : Help Empower Healthcare Professionals Worldwide!

Location:
Lebanon – Remote
Employment:
Full-time
Working Hours:
10:00 am – 6:00 pm Sydney time
Compensation: Up to US$2,500 per month
depending on experience and assessment.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time. You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish
, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

What You Will Do

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems.
Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines.
Communicate project progress, risks, delays and required decisions clearly to management.
Run project meetings and ensure actions, owners and deadlines are clearly documented.
Follow up with team members on outstanding deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed deadlines.
Work closely with management to prioritize projects and allocate resources effectively.
Improve existing workflows, processes and project management systems.
Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required.
Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

What We Require

Minimum 4 years of professional website development project management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.
Ability to identify problems early and propose practical solutions rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Technically fluent in dev workflows, including sprint planning, QA processes, and coordinating between design, development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Experience using project management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or similar
.
Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.

Highly Regarded

Experience working in a digital marketing agency, technology company or similar fast-paced digital environment
.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.
Experience with Monday.com
.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:
Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.
Project information is accurate and consistently maintained.
You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organized and efficient as a result of your involvement.

The Person We're Looking For

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging unrealistic timelines and holding people accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality
. When a project is assigned to you, you take responsibility for moving it forward and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Meaningful perks that reflect our commitment:

Competitive salary, inclusive of a monthly retention bonus.
Remote position (work from anywhere)
, full-time, and long-term
Annual compensation review
Fitness subsidy for 12 months to support your well-being.
Birthday leave, so you can celebrate and enjoy your special day off!
We observe local public holidays, allowing team members to rest and celebrate their national holidays.
15 days of Paid time off, ensuring team members have time to relax and recharge.
Global exposure and friendly work environment
Opportunity to learn new techniques & tools with a young and dynamic team
Lead performance with autonomy and visibility across departments.
Remote-first, collaborative culture that values initiative and outcomes.

Our Commitment

Mediboost is proudly an equal-opportunity employer.
We celebrate diversity, welcome individuality, and create a space where every voice is heard and valued.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Project Manager
is a full-time, permanent role responsible for managing True Insight's client projects from initial opportunity assessment, scoping, estimating, and proposal development through project delivery and completion.

This remote role works closely with leadership, account management, research, strategy, design, development, digital advertising partners, vendors, and freelance specialists to ensure projects are accurately scoped, realistically estimated, and delivered on time and within budget.

The successful candidate MUST have a marketing, market research, consulting, or marketing agency background
and understand how integrated marketing projects are scoped, estimated, resourced, managed, and delivered.

This is not primarily a social media or content coordination role.
Projects include market research and strategy engagements, visual brand identity, websites, creative campaigns, digital advertising creative, and other integrated marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery
Manage marketing and market research projects from internal kickoff through final delivery, ensuring work stays on schedule, within scope, and on budget.
Build and maintain detailed ClickUp project plans, including tasks, milestones, dependencies, deadlines, budgets, and resource assignments.
Lead internal kickoffs to align teams on project objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines.
Coordinate the day-to-day work of internal teams, freelancers, vendors, and specialists, ensuring clear assignments, timely handoffs, and accountability.
Manage resource availability, workloads, freelancer hours, costs, and project allocations.
Monitor progress, anticipate delays, scope changes, and resource conflicts, and proactively resolve or escalate issues.
Coordinate client inputs, feedback, revisions, and approvals, ensuring required internal quality reviews are completed before delivery.
Maintain accurate project documentation, status updates, and communication with internal teams and Account Leads.

Proposals, RFPs, Scoping & Budget Management
Review client requests, sales notes, and RFPs to assess requirements, project fit, timelines, budgets, and potential risks.
Develop scopes of work outlining deliverables, activities, assumptions, exclusions, timelines, and resource requirements across research, strategy, branding, websites, creative campaigns, digital advertising, and recurring marketing initiatives.
Prepare detailed project estimates, including internal hours, freelancer costs, vendor quotes, and other expenses, validating assumptions with relevant specialists.
Draft and coordinate proposals and RFP responses, gathering required inputs, supporting materials, and documentation while ensuring accuracy and compliance with submission requirements.
Prepare scopes, estimates, proposals, and RFP responses for leadership review and approval.
Coordinate project requirements with Research and Strategy Leads, creative teams, technical specialists, and digital advertising partners to ensure accurate scoping and delivery planning.
Support Account Leads with routine client communication, outstanding information, timelines, feedback, and approvals.
Track actual project hours and costs against approved estimates, identifying scope creep, budget variances, and profitability risks.
Coordinate change-order estimates and provide accurate information for invoicing and profitability reporting.

The Project Manager owns project coordination and delivery, while strategic, creative, research, technical, and media decisions remain with the appropriate Project Lead or specialist.

Qualifications

Required Experience & Work Requirements
Marketing, market research, consulting, or agency experience is REQUIRED.

4–8+ years of project management experience within a marketing agency, marketing research firm, consultancy, creative agency, digital agency, or similar environment.
Proven experience managing internal teams, freelance specialists, vendors, and distributed teams.
Demonstrated experience developing project scopes, estimates, budgets, and client proposals.
Experience reviewing or coordinating RFP responses.
Proven ability to manage multiple integrated marketing projects simultaneously.
Experience managing projects involving several of the following:
Market research and strategy
Visual brand identity and creative campaigns
Website design and development
Digital advertising
Copywriting and content development
Strong project planning, estimating, budget management, and resource coordination skills.
Excellent written communication, attention to detail, organization, and proactive problem-solving abilities.
Experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Wrike, or similar project management software.
Proficiency with Google Workspace preferred. 

Assets
Experience estimating complex research or integrated marketing engagements.
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Project Management, or a related field.
Experience managing formal RFP submissions.

The Fine Print
Full-time, permanent opportunity reporting to the President of the company.
Primarily remote role.
Must have reliable high-speed internet and an appropriate remote work setup.
The role will be in the English language and requires someone who is a native English speaker.
Core office hours are 7:30 AM–4:30 PM MT.
Team members must have at least 4 hours of overlap with True Insight's business hours.
Compensation is competitive and based on experience in the range of $1, 200 - $1,700 CAD/month
, plus bonus for those who become eligible based on our bonus program.

Why True Insight Marketing?
True Insight Marketing is a research-driven strategy firm. Insight is not a department here — it is the backbone of how we help clients gain clarity, confidence, and competitive advantage.
Our work spans research and strategy through implementation, including brand identity, websites, creative campaigns, digital advertising, and ongoing growth initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to manage varied, meaningful projects while working with a highly experienced network of strategists, researchers, creatives, technical specialists, and partners.

Working with us offers:

✔️ Ongoing training & professional development
– Learn our approach and continue building your integrated marketing and project management expertise.
✔️ Work-life balance
– Thrive both professionally and personally.
✔️ A collaborative, supportive culture
– We believe great work comes from great teams.
✔️ Opportunities for growth
– Work across research, strategy, creative, digital, and implementation projects while developing broader leadership capabilities.
✔️ Paid vacation and sick leave, 13th Month pay
– Plus additional perks and benefits.

The Company

Our client is an award-winning architecture and design firm with an established presence across North America, known for delivering high-quality projects across a range of sectors, including healthcare and institutional design. They are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join their team in Toronto, working on healthcare projects throughout the Greater Toronto Area.

This position offers the opportunity to lead complex healthcare projects while overseeing project delivery, client relationships, financial performance, and multidisciplinary teams. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with client expectations and contractual requirements.

THE ROLE

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing healthcare architecture projects from initial planning through completion.
Develop, negotiate, and oversee project scopes, deliverables, work plans, schedules, and budgets across all project phases.
Prepare detailed work plans, allocate project resources and hours, and monitor progress against established timelines and financial targets.
Maintain a thorough understanding of project scope and manage changes effectively to ensure contractual obligations and client expectations are met.
Coordinate with contractors, subconsultants, and relevant authorities to resolve constructability challenges, technical issues, and client concerns.
Build and maintain strong client relationships while acting as the central liaison between clients, contractors, consultants, and internal project teams.
Lead multidisciplinary project teams, monitor performance, forecast revenue, and manage project financials to support successful delivery.
Oversee project execution from design and documentation through construction administration and final completion.

What's Required

5+ years of professional experience within an architecture or architectural design firm, including at least 2 years working on healthcare projects.
Demonstrated project management experience, ideally involving hospitals, clinics, medical facilities, or other healthcare environments.

Strong client management skills, with the ability to build relationships and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Knowledge of applicable Ontario Building Code requirements, healthcare regulations, accessibility standards, and municipal bylaws.
Experience coordinating multidisciplinary consultants, contractors, and other project stakeholders.

Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior Project Manager – Professional Services is a customer facing role responsible for managing Vascular Access, Respiratory, Solutions, Consumables and Oncology franchises. Implementation projects for ICU Medical customers as well as managing the overall customer experience. The role leads assigned projects in a project management capacity, as well as presents issues, recommendations, and updates to customers and internal stakeholders on the assigned projects.

Provide implementation project leadership, organize, and lead team through complex, multidisciplinary projects.
May be involved in larger projects under supervision of Senior Program Manager.
Manage Service Delivery including scope, resources and timelines
Collaborate with customers to identify, communicate and manage engagement risks.
Manage all engagements within predefined performance targets including customer satisfaction and profitability.
Analyze project forecast, timeline, budget, reports, and metrics to ensure project deliverables.
Facilitate contingency planning, project risk assessment, and other decision-making activities on an as needed basis.
Present to a variety of audiences and varied settings.
Support select sales activities and presentations as the subject matter expert.

Knowledge Skills And Qualifications

Self-motivated and skilled at working independently
Project Management experience required, including cross functional collaboration, budget management, project scheduling/timeline management, and resources planning
PMP certification a plus
Strong comprehension and communication skills (verbal and written)
Computer skills required: MS Word, MS Excel, PowerPoint,
Excellent Presentation Skills, ability to make effective presentations to all levels of management

Registered Nurse with current licensure

Stand and/or walk for extended periods (up to 6–8 hours per shift).

Perform repetitive motions such as bending, reaching, stooping, climbing, or kneeling.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager based in India.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager with a strong technical background to lead complex cloud implementation, migration, and operational projects for enterprise healthcare clients. In this role, you will oversee end-to-end project delivery, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are consistently met. You will act as the key link between engineering teams, technical support, security specialists, and client stakeholders, translating complex technical challenges into clear, actionable updates. You will also drive process improvements, manage escalations, and ensure that projects adhere to strict healthcare security and compliance requirements. This position offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with strategic project leadership in a remote, collaborative environment. The role follows a Monday-to-Friday evening shift, with working hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST.

Accountabilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of cloud implementations, migrations, and operational projects for enterprise healthcare clients, ensuring successful outcomes within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality expectations.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, budgets, schedules, resource forecasts, and time-tracking processes.
Provide regular project status reports, progress updates, and risk assessments to executive stakeholders and clients.
Establish, implement, and maintain standardized procedures for Professional Services engagements in collaboration with internal teams.
Coordinate cross-functional activities across engineering, technical support, and security teams, promoting accountability and efficient execution without micromanaging technical work.
Serve as the primary point of contact between technical teams and clients, translating technical issues, delivery milestones, and project dependencies into clear and actionable communications.
Proactively identify project risks, technical bottlenecks, and operational challenges, implementing mitigation strategies and managing escalations throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Design, implement, and maintain scalable project workflows that provide transparency, improve collaboration, and ensure clear visibility for internal teams and clients.
Oversee technical handoffs and project activities to ensure compliance with applicable healthcare security, regulatory, and operational standards.
Manage large project portfolios, monitor delivery performance, and drive continuous improvements in project management processes and service delivery.

Requirements

7–10+ years of dedicated project management experience, with a proven ability to lead complex projects and support technical teams delivering enterprise-level services.
A mandatory hands-on technical background in IT operations, systems administration, cloud infrastructure, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Demonstrated ability to understand technical architectures, engage confidently in engineering discussions, and translate technical requirements into practical project plans.
Mandatory experience with the Atlassian ecosystem, particularly Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management, for project tracking, workflow configuration, collaboration, and documentation.
Proven experience managing large project portfolios and delivering enterprise projects in highly regulated environments, ideally within healthcare technology or managed services.
Strong project planning, budgeting, scheduling, reporting, risk management, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and implementation or migration projects across environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is highly relevant.
A Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred but not mandatory.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, executives, and enterprise clients.
Strong critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, particularly when managing complex technical challenges and competing priorities.
Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and take ownership of outcomes.
Willingness to work remotely from India on a Monday-to-Friday schedule, from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Company

Medline Industries, LP is a leading healthcare company dedicated to improving the delivery of healthcare services through innovative products and solutions. With a global presence and a strong commitment to quality, Medline offers a comprehensive range of medical supplies, equipment, and services to healthcare providers worldwide. The organization prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment, emphasizing continuous improvement, and maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism. As a trusted partner in healthcare, Medline strives to support its clients in delivering exceptional patient care while promoting employee growth and development.

About The Role

The Project Manager role at Medline is a vital position responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of small to medium-scale projects within the organization. Under moderate supervision, the successful candidate will oversee project planning, execution, and completion, ensuring alignment with business objectives, scope, schedule, and budget. This role requires a proactive individual capable of managing multiple stakeholders, mitigating risks, and fostering cross-functional collaboration. The Project Manager will serve as a key point of contact for project teams and stakeholders, providing clear communication, status updates, and strategic guidance to ensure project success. The position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to impactful projects that enhance healthcare delivery and operational efficiency across the organization.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's Degree in a related field, such as Business Administration, Project Management, or Healthcare Management. A minimum of 2-4 years of proven experience in project management, particularly managing projects with higher risk, visibility, and stakeholder complexity, is required. Certification such as PMP (Project Management Professional) is highly preferred. Candidates should demonstrate proficiency with project management methodologies, tools, and governance frameworks, along with excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. The ability to manage competing priorities, influence stakeholders at various levels, and adapt to changing environments is essential. A strong understanding of project lifecycle management and risk mitigation strategies will contribute to success in this role.

Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of small to medium-scale projects, ensuring objectives, milestones, and outcomes are achieved on time and within scope and budget.
Develop comprehensive project plans, set clear milestones, and define deliverables to facilitate successful project execution.
Allocate resources effectively, manage project budgets, and monitor progress to ensure projects remain on track.
Proactively identify potential risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate concerns as necessary to stakeholders and leadership.
Track key performance indicators (KPIs), monitor project performance, and generate regular status reports for stakeholders.
Facilitate team meetings, coordinate cross-functional activities, and maintain ongoing communication with stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by recommending workflow enhancements, template updates, and new tools or technologies to optimize project delivery processes.
Manage stakeholder expectations through effective communication and collaboration, ensuring all parties are informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.

Benefits

Medline offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of its employees. Employees working 30 or more hours per week are eligible for health insurance, including medical, dental, and vision coverage. The organization also provides life and disability insurance, 401(k) retirement plan contributions, paid time off, and various wellness programs. For roles with less than 30 hours per week, benefits include access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups, and the Employee Service Center. Medline is committed to fostering a positive work environment that encourages professional growth, work-life balance, and a culture of inclusion and belonging. Employees are also supported through ongoing training, development opportunities, and recognition programs to help them thrive in their careers.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Project Manager, Capture and Optimization of Research Data (CORD) Platform
jobs.description:
Do you want to work for a world-renowned research institute that pushes the boundaries of biomedical science and health research? Right here in Montreal! At the Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC), you can be part of an organization focused on scientific discovery and innovation in patient-centered medicine. Join us today and make a difference!

Job Description

RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF THE MUHC

The Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC) is a world-renowned biomedical and hospital research centre. Located in Montreal, Quebec, the Institute is the research arm of the McGill University Health Centre (MUHC) affiliated with the Faculty of Medicine at McGill University. The RI-MUHC is supported in part by the Fonds de recherche du Québec - Santé (FRQS).

Position Summary

The Research Institute of the MUHC is seeking an interim Project Manager to join the Capture and Optimization of Research Data (CORD) platform of the Centre for Outcomes Research and Evaluation (CORE). CORD provides researchers with expert support, technical resources, and methodological tools to facilitate data operations across the full study lifecycle. Reporting to the Associate Director (scientific) and the CORE Manager (administrative), the incumbent will support Principal Investigators with data collection tool development, electronic data capture implementation, and data management. The incumbent will also contribute to platform policy development and building internal capacity across the Institute.

General Duties

Strategic & Protocol Support

Provide strategic support to Principal Investigators for research data-related operations, including conceptualization of data collection, linkage, management, and documentation strategies.
Review study protocols and proposed measurement tools, advise on collection, management, and quality control strategies.
Collaborate with the Biostatistical Consulting Unit (BCU) to align CRF structure and data design with downstream analytical needs.

Electronic Data Capture & REDCap

Review or co-design questionnaires and case report forms (CRFs), select appropriate electronic data capture (EDC) software.
Program questionnaires and CRFs in REDCap, including advanced features (randomization, calculated fields, branching logic, API integrations, plugins).
Lead pre-deployment testing and quality control of data collection procedures.
Provide specialized training and support to research teams in the use of REDCap.
Build and maintain robust internal REDCap support capacity, expand platform capabilities over time.

Data Management & Quality

Support data extraction, cleaning, integration, versioning, and maintenance of research databases.
Collaborate with database managers and programmers for EDC implementation and quality control.
Develop familiarity with other EDC, data management, and data banking systems as needed.

Policy, Resources & Collaboration

Develop and improve data policy documents, integrity procedures, and strategies to address identified gaps.
Create and maintain a library of methodological resources, guidelines, standards, and templates.
Build expertise across the RI-MUHC in study design review, CRF creation, and data management best practices.
Collaborate with RI-MUHC IT, the Centre for Innovative Medicine, and other RI-MUHC departments.
Contribute to special projects as assigned by CORE Management or the Platform Associate Director.

Website of the organization

https://rimuhc.ca/en

Education / Experience

Education: Master's Degree

Field of study: Epidemiology, data science, health informatics, biostatistics, mathematics or a closely related field.

Work Experience: Minimum three (3) years of experience in clinical project management and clinical trials, with study protocols, case report forms, and electronic data capture systems.

Required Skills

Knowledge of complex scientific issues and solid analytical skills.

Strong writing skills, including ability to develop policy documents, SOPs, and technical guides.
Excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills, comfortable working with diverse research teams.
Self-motivated, able to work independently and collaboratively with minimal supervision.
Proficiency in REDCap (database setup, logic, randomization, API) – required.
Experience in data structure, management, cleaning, and quality control – required.
Programming skills and knowledge of R or another programming language – asset.
Advanced knowledge of oral and written French
Advanced knowledge of oral and written English due to regular or complex oral or written contact with researchers or international students who are exclusively proficient in English, as well as complex writing or in-depth analysis of documents in English related to a research project.

The Commercial Strategy team sits within the Business Development & Commercial Programs org and is responsible for helping take ideas from 0 to 1 by leading strategic initiatives and bets, and partnering cross functionally with other teams to test, experiment, and implement new strategies. The Partner Operations sub-team is the engine behind Thumbtack's partnerships business. As a Partner Operations Analyst at Thumbtack, you'll play a key role in keeping our partnerships business running smoothly while helping build the processes and systems that support its growth. You'll own partner onboarding and ongoing operational support, work closely with internal teams and external partners, and help turn new partnership initiatives into scalable, repeatable operations.

This role is a mix of hands-on execution, cross-functional project management, and continuous improvement. You'll have the opportunity to lead projects independently, use AI and automation to simplify workflows, and help launch new programs as our partnerships business evolves. We're looking for someone who's organized, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity—someone who enjoys solving problems, taking ownership, and finding better ways to get things done.

Own the partner onboarding pipeline from Partner Application Portal to Pro Marketplace, making sure every partner is set up, live, and active.

Lead independent projects from scoping, planning, and delivery, driving process and systems improvements by managing timelines and dependencies across teams.
Build and maintain automation, including AI tools, for data collection, tracking, and reporting so the team spends less time on manual work.
Support new pilots and partnership launches, from fulfillment and refunds to pro surveys and early program feedback.
Partner with Engineering, external developers, Partnerships, and Support to resolve issues, test new tools, and move process improvements forward.

Experience owning a process end to end, from mapping and documenting it to improving it.
A track record of delivering a cross-functional project where you set the plan, managed dependencies, and can point to the result.
Comfortable with Salesforce, Jira, and spreadsheets; experience building dashboards or reports, and exposure to APIs and product integrations.
Experience using AI or automation tools to cut down on manual work.
Clear written and verbal English, and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including external partners.
Able to work U.S. hours, including graveyard shifts, with occasional schedule changes.

jobs.title: Program Manager of Technical Development
jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

Program Manager of Technical Development

Position Location:

Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major US airport.

Job Summary

The Program Manager of Technical Development is responsible for the technical quality, standards, and capability of the Field Services workforce. This role ensures that commissioning execution is technically rigorous and consistent across all projects and sites — not dependent on the expertise of specific individuals — by developing field competency, owning technical standards and SOPs, and driving continuous improvement of processes and workflows.

The Program Manager of Technical Development partners directly with the Program Manager – Projects and Program Manager – People verticals and reports to the Associate Director, providing the technical input that informs staffing readiness, delivery risk, and training investment decisions across the program.

This role's primary objective is to ensure the technical execution of commissioning work is correct, consistent, and scalable across all Field Services programs, and to build a workforce technically capable of handling complex systems and abnormal conditions without dependency on a small group of senior experts.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Own Technical Standards and Processes (30%)

Develop, implement, and maintain commissioning SOPs, workflows, templates, and client programmatic requirements across all programs
Ensure consistent application of technical standards across all active projects and sites; monitor compliance and address deviations proactively
Own the technical onboarding process for new projects and programs: ensure workflows are integrated, client-specific requirements are documented, and field teams are trained prior to execution
Maintain a centralized, accessible repository of technical processes, deliverables, and field insights
Provide technical input on proposals and scope reviews to ensure execution approach, staffing qualifications, and deliverable commitments are technically sound

Develop Field Capability and Competency (25%)

Identify technical skill gaps across the workforce and develop structured plans to close them through training, mentoring, and field coaching
Deliver or coordinate onsite technical training, hands-on instruction, and real-time coaching during commissioning execution
Ensure the workforce develops depth in troubleshooting, system-level understanding, and abnormal condition response — not just procedural execution capability
Partner with Program Manager – People on development planning; provide technical competency input into promotion readiness calibration
Assess Technical Lead and SME performance; identify development needs and succession candidates within the technical track

Manage Technical Escalation and Field Oversight (20%)

Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues during commissioning and testing; resolve at the Program Manager of Technical Development level before escalating to the Associate Director
Provide direct technical oversight and support during critical project phases, high-risk testing activities, or complex system integrations
Ensure accuracy and technical rigor in testing documentation, commissioning plans, and reports
Audit technical deliverable quality across active projects; identify recurring issues and initiate root cause analysis and standards updates as needed
Conduct regular site visits to observe technical execution firsthand, validate standards compliance, and deliver field coaching

Drive Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Management (15%)

Capture lessons learned across projects and systematically incorporate findings into SOPs, workflows, and training content
Drive iterative improvement of technical processes — standards should become more efficient, scalable, and consistently adopted over time
Identify recurring technical execution gaps and develop programmatic responses rather than one-off interventions
Contribute to routine reporting by preparing the technical capability and standards compliance section for Associate Director review and compilation

Ensure Cross-Functional Alignment and Project Onboarding (10%)

Partner with Program Manager – Projects to ensure technical standards are applied in the field; provide early warning on technical gaps that may affect schedule, quality, or delivery risk
Partner with Program Manager – People to align training priorities with workforce readiness and communicate technical capability requirements that inform staffing and hiring decisions
Provide technical input to the Associate Director on capability gaps, workforce readiness, and technical risk posture across the program portfolio
Coordinate with the Associate Director of Technical Development on programmatic and departmental standardization and training initiatives

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (advanced Level For All The Following)

Deep technical expertise in electrical and/or mechanical commissioning systems
Demonstrated ability to develop and enforce technical standards at program scale
Experience developing SOPs, workflows, and technical process documentation
Advanced troubleshooting and system-level thinking capability
Strong training, mentoring, and technical knowledge-transfer capability
Ability to translate field observations into scalable process improvements
Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve standards development, training delivery, and technical documentation
Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth, distributed, remote environment
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues
Proficient in MS Office Suite and commissioning documentation tools
Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

Approximately 50% domestic travel; may include any or all 50 US states
Occasional international travel required based on program needs
Must reside near a major airport
Must hold a valid driver's license and ability to rent vehicles
Must hold or be able to obtain a valid REAL ID or passport for domestic air travel
Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field — or equivalent experience

PLUS

Minimum 8 years' experience in commissioning or mission-critical construction
Must hold or be able to obtain NFPA 70E and OSHA 30 certifications as required

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
Flex spending accounts (FSA)

Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents

Paid parental leave after one year of employment

jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to help turn advanced hardware systems into reliable, production-ready products. In this role, you will lead the post-silicon productization of high-performance PCIe cards and high-power, multi-chip server systems, coordinating complex work across the full development lifecycle. You will bring structure and momentum to programs by aligning objectives, milestones, resources, risks, and deliverables. Success will depend on your ability to build strong partnerships across product management, hardware, software, supply chain, manufacturing, NPI, and external suppliers.

This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, Canada.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

A technically grounded program leader who builds alignment across diverse teams and keeps complex initiatives moving toward clear outcomes.
A clear and proactive communicator who can turn open issues into decisions, maintain visibility into program health, and influence without relying on direct authority.
Curious and adaptable, with the judgment to use AI tools responsibly to improve research, planning, analysis, documentation, and day-to-day execution.
Comfortable navigating product development across PCB or mechanical design, software and firmware, validation, NPI operations, ODMs, and external suppliers.
An engineer with a bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related technical field, with at least 4 years of product design or validation experience and 3 or more years leading projects or technical programs.

What We Need

Establish integrated program plans covering scope, schedules, resource needs, performance requirements, sourcing, manufacturing, testing, and release readiness.
Coordinate module-level and system-level validation, including compliance, reliability, life testing, and other activities required to launch a successful product.
Monitor execution closely, raise risks early, and partner with stakeholders to create practical mitigation plans and resolve issues.
Maintain the documentation and communication needed by engineering, manufacturing, customer-service, and leadership teams, including test procedures, drawings, bills of materials, reports, and program-review presentations.

What You Will Learn

The realities of bringing complex compute hardware from post-silicon evaluation into a manufacturable and supportable product.
The dependencies that connect engineering decisions with supply chain execution, ODM coordination, manufacturing readiness, validation, and customer support.
Ways to build effective release plans around performance targets, system validation, compliance, reliability, and production readiness.
New approaches to leading through ambiguity, building trust across functions, and helping technical teams make progress on difficult problems.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

How You Will Impact Skylo

Skylo is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to solve the complex challenge of synchronizing our cloud-native software evolution with global network implementation and hardware certification. You will be the primary driver behind the world’s first live direct-to-device satellite service, ensuring that code deployed in the cloud works flawlessly with physical infrastructure on the ground and partner devices in the field. This role is not just about tracking tasks; it is about navigating the technical trade-offs between rapid software iteration and the rigorous, long-lead requirements of satellite network operations. You will resolve the systemic ambiguity that arises when software, hardware, and vendors collide, ultimately ensuring that our global network scales reliably as we expand across five continents.

This role is located in Mountain View, California (On-Site)

How You Will Contribute

Drive the end-to-end integration of cloud-native software releases with physical network implementation across our global satellite ground stations.
Synchronize hardware development cycles with firmware and software milestones to ensure seamless device certification with OEM and chipset partners.
Navigate technical trade-offs between terrestrial roaming requirements and non-terrestrial network (NTN) performance standards.
Resolve systemic ambiguity between software engineering, network operations, and external satellite operators to maintain 99.9% service availability.
Define and track critical path dependencies for multi-continent network deployments, including regulatory and infrastructure milestones.
Partner across teams to clarify requirements and drive decisions on resource allocation during high-stakes launch windows.
Establish scalable post-launch retrospectives that transform operational bottlenecks into automated deployment workflows.
Manage high-leverage risks associated with global spectrum coordination and hardware supply chains to prevent project slippage.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field that provides a foundation in both software and hardware systems.
5+ years of experience managing complex engineering programs that integrate cloud-native software with physical infrastructure or telecommunications hardware.
Proven ability to synchronize the software development lifecycle (SDLC) with hardware testing and network deployment milestones.
Deep understanding of the technical constraints associated with network implementation, including spectrum coordination or ground station operations.
Experience navigating device certification processes and 3GPP standards in partnership with chipset makers or OEMs.
History of managing high-stakes vendor relationships and external satellite operator partnerships to hit critical launch dates.
Expertise in adapting agile software practices to fit the rigid, long-lead timelines of physical network infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated capability in using analytical skills to identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks across cross-functional engineering teams.
Experience applying sound judgment to balance rapid software iteration with the reliability requirements of a live global network.
Record of driving alignment between technical engineering requirements and non-technical business objectives in a fast-paced environment.
Expert level experience with program management tools such as JIRA

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we offer an attractive range of benefits:

Competitive compensation packages including a stock option-based equity program
Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plan
Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
A generous time-off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
A once-in-a-career opportunity to operate the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network
Access to a world-class team across software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite, and network virtualization
Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic, and South Asia characteristics

The estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000 — $140,000
. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant training.

In addition to base salary, Skylo offers a competitive benefits package including health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and equity options.

Help

You will conduct program analyses and deliver high-level briefings to senior leadership.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The People & Business Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating, managing, and optimizing internal operations across business units, ensuring operational efficiency, organizational alignment, and business performance.
Reporting directly to the Head of Business, this role drives operational effectiveness through three key pillars: People, Systems, and Financial Performance.
Acting as a central operational partner to business leaders and corporate functions, the role translates business priorities into structured execution, monitors performance, strengthens internal processes, and enables teams to operate efficiently as the business grows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Business & Organizational Operations
Manage and coordinate day-to-day internal operations across business units, ensuring alignment with business priorities, timelines, and approved budgets.
Establish and maintain operational workflows, reporting structures, approval processes, and cross-functional coordination mechanisms.
Lead weekly and monthly operational reviews, track action items, identify bottlenecks, and follow through on issue resolution.
Coordinate with business leaders and corporate functions, including Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Project Management, to ensure efficient execution and accountability.
Monitor organizational workload, operational capacity, and resource utilization; identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
Support the Head of Business in translating management decisions into actionable plans with clear ownership, timelines, and expected outcomes.

2. People Operations & Organizational Effectiveness
Coordinate annual and quarterly workforce planning, including headcount requirements, recruitment priorities, and personnel budget tracking.
Partner with Corporate HR and business leaders on recruitment planning, onboarding, performance reviews, and employee development initiatives.
Maintain organizational structures, job descriptions, role responsibilities, and reporting lines to ensure clarity and accountability.
Coordinate performance management cycles, consolidate evaluation results, and follow up on agreed development actions.
Identify people-related operational challenges and recommend improvements in team structure, workload allocation, and collaboration.
Support internal communication, employee engagement, and culture-building initiatives in collaboration with Corporate HR.

3. Business & Financial Performance Management
Work closely with Finance and business leaders to coordinate annual operating plans (AOP), business budgets, and periodic financial forecasts.
Monitor business performance against approved targets, including revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, and personnel costs.
Prepare monthly and quarterly business performance reports, highlighting budget variances, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
Track cost efficiency, resource utilization, and productivity across business units.
Coordinate financial and operational data reconciliation, ensuring timely and accurate management reporting.
Provide business insights and recommendations to support leadership in resource allocation, cost optimization, and operational decision-making.

4. Systems, Processes & Governance
Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve internal SOPs, workflows, approval matrices, and reporting standards.
Ensure operational compliance with approved corporate policies and internal governance requirements.
Coordinate with Finance, HR, Legal, and Procurement to address compliance requirements, operational risks, and documentation.
Maintain centralized management dashboards and tracking systems to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Identify opportunities for workflow automation, data integration, and digital tools to improve operational productivity.
Drive process adoption and ensure consistent implementation across business units.

5. Cross-Functional Alignment & Operational Improvement
Act as a key coordination point between business units and corporate functions.
Translate strategic priorities from the Head of Business into measurable operational initiatives.
Monitor the implementation of organizational changes, new operating models, and internal improvement projects.
Proactively identify operational gaps, dependencies, and risks; propose solutions and escalate critical decisions when needed.

Company Description

Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.

And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport.

Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.

PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life

Job Description

This practice is built for the way enterprise software actually gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses.

As a Product Strategist, you'll help clients identify which problems are worth solving and shape products that deliver measurable value. Working alongside AI Engineers and Data Engineers, you'll take opportunities from discovery through adoption, combining deep business understanding with a practical view of what technology can achieve. The person defining the product is also accountable for whether it gets used, which means you'll stay close to the outcome long after launch.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. AI agents are changing how products are built, but they cannot decide what should be built in the first place. You'll work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and help clients move from broad ambitions to solutions that create lasting impact.

As part of the Digital Products & AI team, you can expect to:

Lead discovery with clients to understand how work gets done, where value is being lost, and which opportunities are worth pursuing.
Define product requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and success measures that guide delivery and enable measurable outcomes.
Translate business challenges into products, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent workflows that people will trust and adopt.
Shape how AI capabilities are applied, including what should be automated, where human oversight is required, and how success should be evaluated.
Drive adoption by aligning stakeholders, supporting change, and helping clients redesign processes where necessary to realize value.
Create reusable approaches, assets, and industry insights that strengthen future engagements, with the strongest ideas becoming capabilities and offerings we take to market.

Qualifications

You have a track record of defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions that create measurable business outcomes. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work.

To be successful, you'll have:

Product and strategy foundations

Experience in product management, product strategy, consulting, or a similar role focused on defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions.
Experience leading discovery, shaping product direction, and translating complex business challenges into actionable plans.
Experience building business cases, defining success measures, and demonstrating value realization.

Industry and AI understanding

Deep expertise in at least one industry sector, with the ability to quickly establish credibility with both operational and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of AI-enabled products, including agents, retrieval approaches, automation, and the opportunities and limitations of modern AI systems.
Experience evaluating competing opportunities and making informed decisions about where technology can create the greatest impact.

Enterprise delivery

Experience working with multidisciplinary teams to deliver technology solutions from concept through implementation and adoption.
Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence decisions across multiple levels of an organization.
Commercial judgment and the ability to balance business value, user needs, technical feasibility, and delivery constraints.

Ideally, you'll also bring:

Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or a leadership role within your industry.
Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries.
Experience with change management, operating model design, process transformation, or driving adoption of new technologies.

What makes this a great opportunity?

The Assistant Innovation Project Manager role supports the development and delivery of consumer-led innovation opportunities, translating consumer needs and market opportunities into compelling, commercially viable propositions that strengthen the brand portfolio and deliver incremental growth. It also supports and owns defined innovation projects or workstreams under the guidance of the Head of Innovation, Senior Innovation Manager and Innovation Manager connecting cross-functional expertise from opportunity development through launch and post-launch learning.

Role Responsibilities

Innovation pipeline and project delivery

Support and own defined innovation projects and workstreams, coordinating day-to-day delivery, milestones, dependencies, risks and decision points from concept through launch and post-launch optimisation.
Support preparation of project briefs, status updates, gate materials and recommendations to support timely, evidence-based decisions.
Work across near-term launch delivery and longer-term opportunity development, escalating material changes to scope, cost, timing or proposition.

Consumer-led opportunity and proposition development

Partner with Consumer Insights and Brand teams to translate research, market trends and unmet consumer needs into clear opportunity briefs and testable propositions.
Support concept development, product and pack proposition refinement, consumer testing and synthesis of learning into recommended next steps.
Ensure propositions are aligned with brand strategy, portfolio priorities and intended consumer and customer needs.

Cross-functional orchestration

Support the coordination of cross-functional innovation projects with R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, Insights, Brand, Sales and Shopper experts; establish clear workstream accountabilities, deliverables and dependencies.
Partner with functional experts who lead their respective disciplines, while maintaining visibility of progress, risks and implications for the overall consumer proposition and commercial objectives.
Support and facilitate project meetings focused on decisions, learning, risks and next actions; maintain clear records of agreed actions and ownership.

Commercialisation, governance and launch readiness

Develop and consolidate business-case inputs, including opportunity sizing, volume, pricing, margin and growth potential, in partnership with Finance, Insights and Commercial experts who own their specialist assumptions.
Coordinate governance requirements and stage-gate submissions, maintaining accurate project information in agreed systems and tools (Planisware).
Partner with Brand and customer-facing teams on launch handovers and readiness, without replacing functional ownership of go-to-market execution.

Performance and continuous improvement

Support the definition and tracking of project success measures, including consumer validation, launch readiness and post-launch performance.
Coordinate post-launch reviews, document insights and recommended improvements, and apply learning to future pipeline decisions.
Identify practical improvements to templates, routines and ways of working that make innovation delivery simpler and more effective. Contribute to longer-term pipeline development and innovation and go-to-market capability building.
Support Innovation team operations, including project investment and budget tracking, Buywise purchase order management, expenditure reporting and coordination of administrative processes to enable effective project delivery and financial governance.

Qualifications

Experience and capabilities

Experience in brand management, marketing, innovation, commercial or project coordination within FMCG or a related consumer-led industry.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, organise project plans and follow through on actions and deadlines.
Commercial curiosity and comfort working with basic business cases, consumer research and performance measures.
Strong collaboration, communication and influencing skills; confidence working with functional specialists.
Structured problem-solving, attention to detail, learning agility and willingness to constructively challenge assumptions.
Relevant tertiary qualification in marketing, business or a related discipline desirable, or equivalent practical experience.

Measures of success

Assigned project milestones, governance deliverables and decisions are prepared on time and to an agreed standard.
Clear ownership of workstreams, transparent risks and timely escalation of material trade-offs.
Consumer and commercial evidence is reflected in project recommendations.
Effective collaboration with Brand and functional experts; smooth handovers to launch owners.
Post-launch learning is captured and translated into practical actions.

Employee will be assigned to Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Service (PMRS) - VA Healthcare System - Lexington - KY. Applies advanced management and organizational principles to analyze the administrative health of the service

Summary

You will serve as a PROGRAM ANALYST in the DOCTRINE AND INNOVATION DIRECTOR DIVISION, NAVAL INFORMATION WARFIGHTING DEVELOPMENT CENTER of NAVINFOWARDEVCEN NORFOLK.

Duties

Help

You will identify tactical, doctrinal and capability gaps for the information warfare community and across information related capabilities, and assess innovative materiel and non-materiel solutions.
You will plan and lead updates to, or creation of requisite doctrinal and tactical publications to meet Fleet warfighter needs.
You will directly update/create publications, leading contracted efforts, guiding a Fleet development team, and/or some combination thereof.
You will conduct analyses and develop studies in order to identify new or emerging threats, and their impact on doctrinal publications, and implementation of emerging doctrine and tactics in Fleet training programs and readiness assessments.
You will conduct research, data collection and analysis of a wide spectrum of problems related to the employment of existing, experimental, or projected IW tactics, equipment, and doctrine.
You will develop/support experimentation and exercises that enable development or validation of IW materiel and non-materiel solutions to Fleet capability shortfalls and support training to the Fleet.
You will capture, analyze, validate, and promulgate lessons learned and best practices.

Requirements

Help

jobs.title: Corporate Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana's Corporate Strategy team is a small, collaborative and goal-focused group that works with senior leadership to establish the future course for Humana. In Corporate Strategy, you will identify and analyze growth opportunities and work with business leaders to prioritize options and set the long-term strategy agenda. The team has frequent interactions with Humana's CEO and manages deliverables for Humana's broader Executive Leadership Team and Board of Directors. Our team also undertakes internal consulting engagements across different topics.

The Corporate Strategy Analyst role is modeled after top-tier management consultancies. Daily activities will include developing industry analyses, building high-level financial or other business models, conducting qualitative analyses and synthesizing findings to create executive-level deliverables and recommendations for Humana's senior leaders. Examples of project work include identifying and evaluating growth opportunities across our lines of business. They also include developing market and competitive strategies, assessing partnership and acquisition opportunities, designing operating model / organizational improvements, and supporting pilots / innovation opportunities for various business leaders.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct market research, competitive analyses, and quantitative modeling to support strategic initiatives and business planning efforts
Gather, analyze, and synthesize internal and external data into actionable insights for executive decision-making
Convert strategy into roadmaps, business cases and projects while prioritizing timelines and ensuring alignment and execution
Develop presentations and executive-level materials
Collaborate with Corporate Strategy colleagues, and contribute to a high-performing, inclusive, and supportive team environment

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's degree
1+ years of full-time work experience in strategy consulting or corporate/business unit strategy
Analytical skills (ex: quantitative analysis and research, financial modeling)
Conceptual skills (ex: translating ambiguous problem statements into structured frameworks, generating hypotheses independently and testing them, synthesizing complex information into digestible executive insights, managing cross-functional stakeholders)

Preferred Qualifications

Passion for Humana's focus on value-based healthcare for seniors
Exposure to the healthcare industry

Location:
Working locations are primarily Louisville, KY, and Arlington, VA (Washington, DC metro area); also open to candidates living in or willing to relocate to Chicago or Nashville. The Strategy team operates on a hybrid schedule with an expectation of 2 to 3 in‑office days per week. Relocation assistance available.

Travel:
Occasional travel to Humana offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

$86,200 - $118,600 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description Of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Apply statistical, analytical and algorithmic techniques to uncover trends, patterns and anomalies of complex datasets
Drive consistency in the application of data management system through standardized reporting, analysis, and data visualization.
Partner with operational leadership to identify opportunities for improvement, develop data-driven execution plans and implement those strategies.

Adherence to data privacy, security and regulatory standards.

:

Strong SQL/Kusto and Python/R programming skills for data manipulation and analysis
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure) and cloud-native data services.
Proficiency in ETL workflows, data warehousing and BI tools like Power BI
Sold understanding of statistics, experimental design and predictive modeling.
Excellent analytical thinking, problem solving capability, and attention to detail.
Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex insights effectively.
Familiarity with machine learning and AI-Driven analytics
