jobs.description:
Agency

FleishmanHillard

Job Function

Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction

Data Science and Analytics

Overview

Job Description:

FleishmanHillard, a global communications agency, has an immediate opening for a  Senior Research Analyst
to join our global research and intelligence practice, branded as TRUE Global Intelligence (TGI). Location is flexible and candidates will be considered from the Seattle, Los Angeles or San Francisco greater metro areas
. FleishmanHillard’s TRUE Global Intelligence practice serves as a strategic enabler to the broader organization by harnessing research and data-driven insights to achieve client business objectives. Our work within TRUE Global Intelligence integrates measurement, primary research and secondary research methods with advanced data analytics and strategic consulting.

This position will assist with analyzing and synthesizing data to provide actionable insights and tactical recommendations for the agency’s clients and will be a great opportunity for someone who is interested in PR measurement.

This position will be fully embedded in an exciting, household name client monitoring brand reputation across corporate, consumer and issues workstreams. This person will actively track cultural trends  - and should have a deep understanding of US culture - and signals for proactive media opportunities and activations while identifying emerging reputational and business risks from across the media ecosystem. The role will also contribute to performance measurement reporting and audience insight work. This will be a great opportunity for someone who is already experimenting with AI in a range of research and insights use cases to embed use AI platforms and workflows into your daily routine.

FleishmanHillard, globally headquartered in St. Louis, is one of the largest integrated communications companies in the world. Our service to clients draws on expertise across more than 25 disciplines, including B2C and B2B marketing, branding, corporate reputation management, CSR, creative services, entertainment and sports, digital and social media, financial communications and investor relations, healthcare, internal communications, issues and crisis management, public affairs, and technology. FleishmanHillard believes a diverse team brings a wider range of personal and professional experiences and perspectives.

We recognize that diversity, equity and inclusion benefit our agency, our clients, and the communities in which we work and live. To that end, we strongly encourage applications from women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ community, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

Responsibilities

Participate in integrated research and analytics assignments, which include social and traditional media monitoring, audience analysis, measurement, primary research and use of secondary methodologies.
Actively monitor online conversation around client brands to proactively identify issues, risks and opportunities
Analyze data, draft reports, and collaborate with team members to contribute findings to client discussions and presentations.
Manage the collection, cleaning, and synthesis of data from multiple sources.
Develop and report on KPIs, dashboards and scorecards.
Conduct secondary research and collaborate on research briefs to inform clients and communications teams on a variety of industries.
Recommend communications-centric solutions based on the research results.
Stay current with the latest measurement trends, as well as relevant industry trends.

Qualifications

Ability to join us in a hybrid model of working in-person in the Los Angeleas, San Francisco, or Seattle office weekly.
1 to 2+ years of experience working across a broad range of research categories and models; experience in secondary research. Preferably experience working in an advertising, digital, PR or research agency.
Proven analytical and deductive reasoning skills; able to translate findings into meaningful insights.
Ability to quickly spot patterns and surface actionable insights; separate signal from noise.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively communicate insights to internal and external communications stakeholders.
Comfortable working in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience writing boolean queries and using tools to analyze traditional and social media coverage, including Talkwalker, MuckRack, Facebook Insights, Twitter Analytics, etc.
Collaborative attitude, strong work ethic and ability to thrive and excel in a challenging fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with leveraging AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, CoPilot, etc) as part of daily ways of working

Our Story

We’re more motivated by what we can give than what we receive. That holds true for our colleagues, clients and communities across cultures and time zones. jobs.title: VBT Task Author-AI Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Hello,

Greetings from ZettaMine!!!

Freelancing Opportunity:
We are hiring VBT Task Authors
for a short-term AI Research, Benchmark Task Creation, and Red-Teaming
project focused on evaluating and identifying weaknesses in advanced AI models.
Eligible Locations:
Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Egypt, Ghana, Nigeria, Turkey, Brazil, and Colombia.

Role:
VBT Task Author-AI Research Analyst
Experience:
3+ Years preferred
Mode:
Remote
Commitment:
Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (20 hours/week)
Working Hours:
Minimum 4 hours of overlap with PST working hours.

Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

Technical Qualification:

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative research skills.
Intermediate-to-advanced web research and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) capabilities.
Ability to discover hard-to-find facts using academic archives, public records, local databases, and other reliable sources.
Experience in fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, investigative research, or technical quality assurance.
Familiarity with AI benchmarks such as GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE).
Ability to write clear, precise, and unambiguous research prompts with evidence-backed answer keys.
Strong attention to detail when verifying sources, identifying contradictions, and documenting source URLs.
Ability to analyze AI model outputs, search logs, and research trajectories to identify errors and reasoning weaknesses.

Educational Qualification:

Mandatory:
Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant engineering domain.
Strong research, technical analysis, and documentation skills are preferred.

Experience:

Experience in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task creation, red-teaming, or technical QA review is preferred.
Prior experience designing challenging research tasks that expose weaknesses in advanced AI models is an advantage.
Familiarity with AI model evaluation frameworks and benchmark testing is beneficial.

Availability:

Full-time commitment of 40 hours per week
or part-time commitment of 20 hours per week
.
Minimum 4 hours of overlap with PST working hours
.
Ability to complete assigned research and benchmark tasks within the project timelines.
Availability for the full 4-week engagement
.

Others:

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Strong written communication and documentation skills.
Ability to validate information using primary or highly credible sources.
Experience with prompt-injection or reasoning-trap tasks is an advantage.
Prior experience as a benchmark reviewer, auditor, or quality lead is preferred.
Reliable computer/laptop and stable internet connection.

What You’ll Work On

Research niche topics to discover difficult-to-find facts that challenge advanced AI models.
Verify factual information using primary sources and credible references.
Develop clear, evidence-based benchmark tasks designed to test AI research and reasoning capabilities.
Create precise answer keys supported by reliable evidence and exact source URLs.
Test benchmark tasks against designated state-of-the-art AI models to identify potential weaknesses.
Analyze model outputs, search logs, and intermediate results to determine where and why failures occur.
Distinguish genuine model limitations from ambiguous prompts or insufficient evidence.
Identify recurring failure patterns and apply them across different research domains.
Review tasks created by other contributors to ensure accuracy, clarity, and quality.
Maintain consistent documentation and follow project evaluation guidelines.

Perks of Freelancing

Fully remote work environment.
Flexible full-time or part-time commitment.
Opportunity to contribute to advanced AI training and evaluation projects.
Hands-on experience with AI benchmarking, investigative research, and red-teaming.
Opportunity to help improve the research and reasoning capabilities of next-generation AI models.

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV with us at
md.afreen@zettamine.com

Thanks & Regards,

Saranya M (Afreen)

ZettaMine

jobs.description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Integrity team is dedicated to safeguarding our users on Grab. We are building a centralized, unified Risk and Compliance technology platform using Grab's proven risk and compliance tech, GrabDefence. We use our datasets and advanced AI capabilities to address critical challenges, from ensuring safety and preventing fraud to achieving regulatory compliance. We are involved in the entire data lifecycle, including analyzing user behavior, identifying financial crime anomalies, and developing detection and prevention modules across user onboarding and transaction journeys.

Get to Know the Role

Reporting to the Senior Analytics Manager in the Integrity team, you will be a key analytics partner in operationalizing the Unified Risk Platform that manages risk across the Grab Ecosystem. You will conduct deep-dive analysis on user behaviors, product funnels, and transaction patterns to identify potential risks and new fraud typologies on our partner platforms. Your data-driven insights will directly guide the design of risk detection strategies, the optimization of shared AI/Machine Learning models, and the implementation of crucial risk controls to safeguard a diverse user base from multiple types of fraud and financial crime.

This role is based onsite in our Petaling Jaya office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will be the subject matter expert in using data to analyze fraud loss, business/product performance, and the effectiveness of risk controls across different Grab business verticals.
You will lead the identification of new fraud and risk patterns, developing data-driven rules and strategies to address potential risks using advanced methods like Graph-Based Detection.
You will conduct statistical analyses to ensure the accuracy and efficiency of detection systems, maintaining data and rule integrity.
You will architect automated self-serve capabilities for stakeholders to monitor key risk metrics, attack patterns, and the efficiency of fraud/AML detection systems.
You will collaborate with Grab business teams to support data extractions, audits, and compliance requirements, ensuring all necessary data is provided for assessments.
You will conduct experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of risk controls and recommend improvements based on findings.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

At least 4 years of experience in data-related or quantitative fields.
A Bachelor's Degree in disciplines such as Analytics, Statistics, Software, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering.
Proficiency in SQL, Presto, ETL, Power BI, Python, and Excel.
Experience with the application of experimentation and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, probability distributions, regression, decision trees).
Intermediate understanding and early hands-on exposure towards Gen AI/LLM's including prompt engineering, query optimization, automated insight generation
Proficiency in Feature Engineering (SQL, Spark) to build data inputs for models, with a clear focus on data utility and feature logic rather than data pipeline ownership.
Desirable: Understanding of the risk management, fraud and compliance space (e.g. AML, eKYC) in digital ecosystems

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
The Aboriginal Health & Medical Research Council of NSW (AH&MRC) is the peak body for Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Services across New South Wales. We work alongside our Members to strengthen Aboriginal community-controlled healthcare and improve the health and wellbeing of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and communities.

Our work spans advocacy, policy, workforce development, health promotion, research, training and organisational support. We bring the experience and priorities of our Members into state and national decision-making, advocate for better health systems and investment, and help build the capability and sustainability of the Aboriginal community-controlled health sector.

Join our team of dynamic and innovative people who value and proudly play a meaningful role in supporting the health and wellbeing of Aboriginal people and communities across NSW.

About The Role

The Data Analyst
is responsible for developing and implementing the organisation’s data, reporting and health intelligence functions to support evidence-based decision-making, advocacy, research, evaluation and continuous improvement.

You’ll analyse data from population health, government, Aboriginal health, survey and program sources, applying data analytics, epidemiology and population health principles to identify trends, monitor outcomes and inform strategy.

Working across the organisation and with external stakeholders, you’ll develop dashboards, reports, indicators and evidence products that support Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Services, Closing the Gap priorities and improved health outcomes.

The role also promotes strong data governance, quality, integrity and Aboriginal Data Sovereignty, while building organisational capability in using data and evidence.

Responsibilities

Data & Governance

Develop and maintain data frameworks, governance, standards and processes that support data quality, integrity and effective use.
Establish secure systems for data collection, storage, management and reporting.

Health Intelligence & Analysis

Analyse population health, service utilisation and outcome data to identify trends, disparities, risks and emerging issues.
Apply epidemiological methods to support health surveillance, evidence briefs and Closing the Gap monitoring.

Data Management & Reporting

Source, extract, clean, validate and integrate data from government, population health and sector datasets, working with data custodians as required.
Develop dashboards, reports, scorecards and visualisations using Power BI and related tools to communicate insights clearly.
Maintain secure storage systems, data dictionaries, metadata and documentation.

Research, Evaluation & Stakeholder Support

Support research and evaluation through data analysis, collection tools, performance measures and outcome reporting.
Work with internal teams and stakeholders to identify data needs, provide advice and present findings clearly.

Continuous Improvement

Identify improvements to data systems, reporting and analytical approaches, keeping informed of emerging trends and best practice.
Contribute to organisational planning, continuous improvement and data capability.

Essential Criteria

Qualifications & Experience:

Tertiary qualification in Data Analytics, Statistics, Public Health, Information Management, Research, Economics or a related field.
Demonstrated experience in data analysis, reporting and visualisation, including working with large and multiple datasets.
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SQL and R or similar analytical/statistical tools.
Experience in health, community services, research or Aboriginal health is desirable.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, information management and data quality principles.
Understanding of, and commitment to, Aboriginal Community Controlled Health principles and values.
Able to obtain a National Police Check and current Working with Children Check.

Skills & Knowledge

Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills.
Ability to source, clean, manage and analyse complex datasets with a high level of accuracy.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.
Able to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and team-oriented, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

How To Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their suitability for the role to talent@ahmrc.org.au
. Please include “Data Analyst” in the subject line.

Join Us!

Be part of a transformative initiative that prioritises the health and well-being of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities through innovative research and collaboration. We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer/Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer/Project Manager based in the United States.

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer/Project Manager, you will lead the design and delivery of complex mechanical systems for mission-critical facilities and building projects.

You will oversee engineering activities from early design through construction documentation, ensuring technical excellence, code compliance, and alignment with project objectives.

Working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, vendors, and contractors, you will develop practical solutions that meet demanding performance and reliability requirements.

Your expertise will help shape mechanical infrastructure for critical environments, including data centers, telecommunications facilities, and other specialized buildings.

You will combine advanced mechanical design knowledge with project management, quality assurance, and technical leadership across multiple concurrent projects.

This role offers the flexibility of remote work while requiring occasional site visits and in-person client meetings in California and other relevant locations.

You will also mentor engineering and design professionals, manage project resources, and help deliver high-quality outcomes within established budgets and schedules.

Accountabilities

You will lead mechanical engineering design and project delivery, ensuring that technical solutions meet client requirements, applicable codes, quality standards, and project constraints. Your responsibilities will include:

Lead mechanical design: Develop, review, and coordinate mechanical systems and CAD drawings throughout schematic design (SD), design development (DD), and construction documentation (CD) phases.
Manage project delivery: Coordinate multiple projects, establish work plans, monitor deliverables, manage budgeted hours, and ensure milestones are achieved on schedule.
Develop engineering documentation: Prepare and review load calculations, specifications, scope-of-work narratives, basis-of-design documents, studies, reports, sketches, and other technical deliverables.
Design mechanical systems: Apply expertise in chilled water (CHW), hot water (HW), condenser water, steam, water-source heat pumps, variable- and constant-flow systems, and other building HVAC applications.
Select and evaluate equipment: Perform advanced equipment selection and analysis for chillers, boilers, cooling towers, air terminals, air valves, heat filters, direct-expansion (DX) equipment, fans, coils, and water-source heat pumps.
Apply HVAC engineering principles: Design and evaluate air-side systems, including constant-volume (CV) and variable-air-volume (VAV) systems, as well as hydronic systems and associated equipment.
Analyze building performance: Apply psychrometric principles, total-energy concepts, and an understanding of humid-climate design risks to develop effective mechanical solutions.
Ensure code compliance: Interpret and apply relevant building and mechanical codes, review code-related design elements, and ensure documentation meets regulatory and project requirements.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams: Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, and structural professionals, as well as project coordinators, project managers, clients, and vendors.
Resolve construction issues: Respond to requests for information (RFIs), review submittals, address installation challenges, and manage revisions, including architect's supplemental instructions (ASIs), using established documentation conventions.
Maintain quality and manage risk: Conduct quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) reviews of calculations, drawings, and specifications while applying risk management practices to protect project and client interests.
Provide technical leadership: Direct and mentor designers, establish drawing and specification requirements, review their work, and provide guidance to maintain high engineering and quality standards.
Manage project resources: Develop and monitor work plans in coordination with other project managers, ensuring that design scope, documentation, staffing, and available hours remain aligned.
Support client relationships: Participate in client meetings and vendor discussions, clarify technical requirements, and help deliver project objectives through effective communication and coordination.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced mechanical engineer with strong project management capabilities, advanced building systems knowledge, and the leadership skills needed to deliver technically demanding projects. You should bring:

At least 10 years of experience in mechanical design and/or project management.
A degree in engineering and a valid Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Demonstrated experience in building design and mechanical engineering for complex facilities.
Strong technical proficiency in CAD drawings, engineering calculations, mechanical specifications, and design documentation.
Extensive knowledge of applicable building and mechanical codes and the ability to ensure compliance throughout the design process.
Advanced understanding of HVAC systems, including chilled and hot water systems, hydronic systems, air-side systems, variable- and constant-flow applications, and water-source heat pumps.
Experience with equipment sizing, selection, scheduling, and performance analysis for a range of mechanical and HVAC equipment.
A thorough understanding of psychrometrics, humid-climate design risks, and total-energy concepts.
Strong project planning and management skills, including budget control, resource allocation, schedule management, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects.
Experience reviewing calculations and technical documentation, performing QA/QC, resolving installation issues, and responding to RFIs and submittals.
Proven leadership, mentoring, communication, and multidisciplinary coordination skills.
The ability to work effectively with clients, vendors, contractors, and internal engineering teams.
Experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, or the telecommunications industry is preferred.
Flexibility to work remotely while attending site visits and in-person client meetings as project requirements dictate.

Benefits

Annual salary: $150,000–$170,000, with actual compensation depending on skills, experience, certifications, and work location.
Remote work flexibility: The role offers remote work options, with site visits and in-person client meetings required as needed.
Mission-critical projects: The opportunity to contribute to complex mechanical engineering projects for a major Fortune 500 client.
Technical leadership: The opportunity to lead design activities, mentor engineering professionals, and influence project quality and delivery.
Collaborative environment: Work with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams on challenging building systems projects.
Referral bonus: A $5,000 referral bonus is advertised in the original posting; eligibility and conditions were not specified.

jobs.title: Research Project Manager
jobs.description:
1168054_RR00125488 Job ID: 1168054_RR00125488

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Project Manager.

The Project Manager for xenotransplant will support the Transplant Institute with work by managing the development, implementation and success of xenotransplant (living and brain dead decedent) initiatives. The Project Manager would be responsible for providing advanced range of coordination of these xenotransplant projects. The position would require assistance with the recruitment, enrollment, research data collection, study coordination activities and grant submissions. Performs study monitoring and serves as liaison with internal and external funding agencies. Ensures the accurate execution of research protocols in accordance with Good Clinical Practices, HIPPA, and required obligations to patient/subject, Principal Investigator (PI), Research Team and Sponsor. Interfaces directly with patients/subjects and PI in support of the clinical trials as applicable. Establishes liaisons with relevant parties at the Medical Center that may include: Research Coordinators, Research Pharmacists, Program Managers, Medical Technicians, Clinical Information Systems and Regulatory Services. Opportunity to assist in the initiation and management of research studies. Works under general direction. Places orders to be pended to appropriate provider as related to clinical trials only.

Job Responsibilities

ADMINISTRATIVE: Assemble and maintain project plans and documentation of project and/or program progress using standardized project management tools, in accordance with NYU Langone Health guidelines. Assists in the development and execution of stated goals and objectives for Transplant Institute. Assists in the development of new programs and projects as directed by Transplant Institute. Build and promote constructive working relationships with all stakeholders, using good judgement to provide objective recommendations. Able to balance diverse opinions from all levels of the organization while managing project results for the good of the organization. Recognizing routine problems and recommending suggestions, ideas, and solutions. Organizing, prioritizing, and expediting departmental workflows. Prepare and deliver presentations, analyses, and recommendations for process improvement. Gathers, enters, and/or updates data to maintain reports and databases, as appropriate. Perform ad hoc data analysis to support project planning as needed. Facilitate project team meetings by providing administrative support as needed, including setting meeting objectives/agendas, noting key decisions, and following up on action items. Use standardized project management tools to track key milestones, owners, and target completion dates.

STUDY REGULATIONS: Aware of study regulatory status and keep an up to date copy of regulatory documents. Assists with the informed consent process and ensure that the patient/subject fully understands what is required of them throughout the study. Follows through regularly with the patient/subjects reminding them of visits and compliance. May monitor any outward effects or issues regarding patient/subject safety and report this to the Principal Investigator, Physician and Nurse Practitioner.

DATA MANAGEMENT: Responsible for collecting and auditing patient information for the research project(s). This may include abstraction of data from the patient chart (e.g., laboratory or diagnostic test results, surgical/radiation treatments delivered, adverse drug reactions, etc.); abstraction of data for publications, or data collection from outside physicians offices. Audits and manages data from and into the database. Prepares forms and reports, compiles Recruitment Screens potential patients/subjects for eligibility to the study. This may include gathering information from the medical record, physician referral, advertisement and directly scheduling a visit to evaluate the patient/subject. Reviews all the elements of the screening process with the Principal Investigator that being: inclusion/exclusion criteria, completed informed consent, documentation of the event and the patient/subject willingness to participate in the study.

LABORATORY CLINICAL COMPETENCY: centrifuge, handling, storing and shipping of specimens. Clinical training and didactic competency tests may be required to perform basic procedures as part of position expectations. In house training and certification will be provided. Continuous Learning Position requires ongoing continuing education in all areas of research development (training programs are provided through the SOM). Promotes own professional growth and development in research role and maintains current expertise in area of practice. Maintains annual requirement of 10 CEUs in continuing research education; employee must demonstrate proof of ongoing research education. Serves as a resource to peers and works collaboratively with other disciplines within the area of expertise.

HUMAN SUBJECT RESEARCH/DECEDENT RESEARCH: As applicable oversee the submission of necessary documents required by the NYU Institutional Board (IRB), Research on Decedents Oversight Committee (RDOC), NYU Office of Clinical Trials and any other appropriate parties in order to obtain approval to conduct human subjects research (e.g., ensures the update and submission of necessary documents and/or forms to appropriate destination). Might prepare, audit and submit monthly enrollment statistics to the Office of Clinical Trials, and provides other information in timely manner, as necessary.

REPORTING AND ANALYSIS: Researches, compiles and consolidates data and conducts preliminary analysis to data collected for presentation to sponsoring and regulatory agencies. Provides reports to all necessary parties (e.g., the principal investigator, sponsoring agency, etc.) on the progress of the study as needed. Formulates, prepares database and generates preliminary measurement reports for review by PI. May complete assessments on study subjects/patients following protocol (with proper training); continues to follow-through with items and patients as part of the research study.

GRANTS: Prepares and submits grant applications and other grants related activities such as developing grants applications/proposals and fund-raising activities if applicable. Collects and organizes required paperwork for submission if applicable. Follow up and coordinates resolution of all issues. Reports to the sponsors to fund medical research in the division.

BUDGET: Assists in development of preliminary draft budgets in conjunction with Supervisor/Principal Investigator. Reviews sponsor-proposed budget for adequate coverage and recommend changes as appropriate. Assists in the preparation of funding reports to funding agencies and helps identify new potential sponsors/agents for trials and researches. Monitor budget throughout trial.

DECISION MAKING AND PROBLEM SOLVING: Combines and evaluates information and data to make decisions about relative importance of information and choosing the best solution to solve problems. Resolves complex situations and refers non-solved issues and questions with recommendation to supervisor.

COMMUNICATION/RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHERS: Cooperates, communicates and relates well to all levels of Medical Center. Listens carefully to others in-order to respond appropriately, answer questions or obtain needed information. Communicates ideas, problems, suggestions, and messages in a timely and effective manner. Maintains the confidentiality of all research information.

JUDGEMENT/DECISION-MAKING: Able to recognize problems as they occur; and through the application of appropriate policy/ procedure, determine and/or recommends the appropriate solution. Seeks guidance as necessary for the performance of duties, asks appropriate questions when in doubt and utilizes reference sources/materials to endure accuracy. Advises appropriate personnel of situations/problems requiring intervention or follow-up attention.

Additional Position Specific Responsibilities

About The Company

Savi Gurus is a dynamic and rapidly expanding business and technology consulting firm headquartered in St. Louis. Renowned for its commitment to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional client service, Savi Gurus specializes in providing strategic consulting, process improvement, and technology integration services across various industries. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and continuous learning. With a focus on employee satisfaction, Savi Gurus offers competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive culture that values diversity and excellence. As a forward-thinking organization, it emphasizes the importance of staying ahead of technological trends and empowering its team members to excel in their careers.

About The Role

The Business Analyst Specialist at Savi Gurus plays a vital role in bridging the gap between business needs and technological solutions. This position is responsible for providing operational support, managing new business demands, and ensuring that project deliverables align with strategic organizational objectives. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in process analysis, requirements elicitation, and solution design, with particular expertise in Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and UiPath. The role involves engaging with key stakeholders to understand their requirements, translating business needs into detailed technical specifications, and supporting the delivery of automation projects that generate measurable business value. The Business Analyst Specialist acts as a point of escalation for project issues, fostering robust communication channels between business units and technical teams. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on innovative automation initiatives, contribute to process reengineering, and influence the organization’s digital transformation journey.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will hold a Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution, preferably in Information Technology, Business, or a related field, complemented by at least six years of progressive experience in business analysis or a related role. Expertise in UiPath and RPA is non-negotiable, with proven proficiency in process mapping tools such as Visio. Candidates should demonstrate strong analytical skills, experience with SQL and Excel for data analysis, and familiarity with testing methodologies and software. Knowledge of ITIL frameworks and IT product development methodologies is desirable. Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential, along with the ability to develop functional and non-functional requirements, use cases, and data/process flows. Candidates must be proactive, able to work independently, and excel in managing multiple priorities within a fast-paced environment. Additional preferred qualifications include experience in cost/benefit analysis, business case development, and client relationship management.

Responsibilities

The Business Analyst Specialist will be responsible for establishing and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders to facilitate open communication and clear expectations regarding project deliverables. They will collaborate with business partners to understand needs, prioritize requirements, and ensure alignment with strategic goals. Preparing comprehensive business cases, initiating large projects in partnership with Program Managers, and contributing to requirements elicitation and management are core duties. The role involves analyzing current processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and assisting with process reengineering initiatives. The analyst will document detailed requirements, develop prototypes and mock-ups, and employ business process modeling techniques to ensure clarity and traceability. Leading requirements management activities, providing coaching to junior analysts, and ensuring compliance with change management practices are also key responsibilities. Additionally, the specialist will support quality assurance testing, facilitate end-user acceptance testing, and monitor service level agreements to ensure project success. Regular status reporting, performance measurement, and lessons learned documentation will support continuous improvement efforts.

Benefits

Savi Gurus offers an attractive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional development of its employees. This includes a competitive salary structure, annual performance bonuses, and a matching retirement plan. Employees enjoy company-paid healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, and pharmacy benefits. The organization provides four weeks of paid time off, ten holidays, and a modest training budget to encourage ongoing learning and skill development. The company values work-life balance and fosters a positive work environment where team members are recognized for their contributions and encouraged to grow within the organization. Additional perks include a collaborative culture, opportunities for career advancement, and participation in innovative projects that make a tangible impact on clients and the organization.

Equal Opportunity

Savi Gurus is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse team enhances our ability to serve our clients effectively and innovate continuously. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We are dedicated to providing a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

The Northrop Grumman CIDO Classified Solutions team is seeking a Principal Classified Cybersecurity Analyst
to support information systems lifecycle activities. The selected candidate will be required to work on-site, full-time at our Linthicum, MD location.

The responsibilities of this role will include but not be limited to the following:

Conduct system audits and continuous monitoring activities, covering all security controls, configurations, and operational processes to evaluate the security posture of the information systems.
Perform assessments of systems and networks within the networking environment or enclave and identify where those systems and networks deviate from acceptable configurations, enclave policy, or local policy.
Perform analyses to validate established security requirements and to recommend additional security requirements and safeguards.
Assist in the implementation of the required government policy, make recommendations on process tailoring, and participate in and document process activities.
Establish strict program control processes to ensure mitigation of risks and support the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) of systems; this will include process support, analysis, coordination, security certification testing, security documentation, investigations, software research, hardware introduction and release, emerging technology research, inspections, and periodic audits.
Support the formal Security Test and Evaluation (ST&E) required by each government accrediting authority through pre-test preparations, participation in the tests, analysis of the results, and preparation of required reports.
Document the results of A&A activities, and technical or coordination activities, and prepare the Risk Management Framework body of evidence.

Note: Due to the classified nature of the work being performed, this position does not offer any virtual or telecommute working options. Applicants are encouraged to apply only
if they are willing to work on-site, full-time at our Linthicum, MD campus.

Basic Qualifications

Master’s degree with 3 years of experience, or a Bachelor's degree with 5 years of experience, or an Associates degree with 7 years of experience; a High School Diploma/GED with 9 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a completed degree.
Candidates must meet the U.S. Government 8140 requirements for a Principal Cybersecurity Analyst– Security+ CE; the required certification must be maintained as a condition of continued employment.
Candidates must have a current U.S. Government Secret security clearance (at a minimum), to include a closed investigation date completed within the last 6 years OR must be enrolled in the U.S. Government Continuous Evaluation (CE) Program to be considered; the required security clearance must be maintained as a condition of continued employment.
Candidates must obtain a Special Access Programs (SAP/SAR) clearance before a start date can be established; maintaining this required clearance will be a condition of continued employment.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity or related field.
Knowledge of security tools such as ACAS, Nessus, Splunk, Trellix, and SCAP.
Knowledge of security frameworks and documentation such as NIST, JSIG, DAAG, SSPs, POA&Ms, and SCTMs.

At Northrop Grumman, we are on the cutting edge of innovation. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us!

new_jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Project Manager
is a full-time, permanent role responsible for managing True Insight's client projects from initial opportunity assessment, scoping, estimating, and proposal development through project delivery and completion.

This remote role works closely with leadership, account management, research, strategy, design, development, digital advertising partners, vendors, and freelance specialists to ensure projects are accurately scoped, realistically estimated, and delivered on time and within budget.

The successful candidate MUST have a marketing, market research, consulting, or marketing agency background
and understand how integrated marketing projects are scoped, estimated, resourced, managed, and delivered.

This is not primarily a social media or content coordination role.
Projects include market research and strategy engagements, visual brand identity, websites, creative campaigns, digital advertising creative, and other integrated marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery
Manage marketing and market research projects from internal kickoff through final delivery, ensuring work stays on schedule, within scope, and on budget.
Build and maintain detailed ClickUp project plans, including tasks, milestones, dependencies, deadlines, budgets, and resource assignments.
Lead internal kickoffs to align teams on project objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines.
Coordinate the day-to-day work of internal teams, freelancers, vendors, and specialists, ensuring clear assignments, timely handoffs, and accountability.
Manage resource availability, workloads, freelancer hours, costs, and project allocations.
Monitor progress, anticipate delays, scope changes, and resource conflicts, and proactively resolve or escalate issues.
Coordinate client inputs, feedback, revisions, and approvals, ensuring required internal quality reviews are completed before delivery.
Maintain accurate project documentation, status updates, and communication with internal teams and Account Leads.

Proposals, RFPs, Scoping & Budget Management
Review client requests, sales notes, and RFPs to assess requirements, project fit, timelines, budgets, and potential risks.
Develop scopes of work outlining deliverables, activities, assumptions, exclusions, timelines, and resource requirements across research, strategy, branding, websites, creative campaigns, digital advertising, and recurring marketing initiatives.
Prepare detailed project estimates, including internal hours, freelancer costs, vendor quotes, and other expenses, validating assumptions with relevant specialists.
Draft and coordinate proposals and RFP responses, gathering required inputs, supporting materials, and documentation while ensuring accuracy and compliance with submission requirements.
Prepare scopes, estimates, proposals, and RFP responses for leadership review and approval.
Coordinate project requirements with Research and Strategy Leads, creative teams, technical specialists, and digital advertising partners to ensure accurate scoping and delivery planning.
Support Account Leads with routine client communication, outstanding information, timelines, feedback, and approvals.
Track actual project hours and costs against approved estimates, identifying scope creep, budget variances, and profitability risks.
Coordinate change-order estimates and provide accurate information for invoicing and profitability reporting.

The Project Manager owns project coordination and delivery, while strategic, creative, research, technical, and media decisions remain with the appropriate Project Lead or specialist.

Qualifications

Required Experience & Work Requirements
Marketing, market research, consulting, or agency experience is REQUIRED.

4–8+ years of project management experience within a marketing agency, marketing research firm, consultancy, creative agency, digital agency, or similar environment.
Proven experience managing internal teams, freelance specialists, vendors, and distributed teams.
Demonstrated experience developing project scopes, estimates, budgets, and client proposals.
Experience reviewing or coordinating RFP responses.
Proven ability to manage multiple integrated marketing projects simultaneously.
Experience managing projects involving several of the following:
Market research and strategy
Visual brand identity and creative campaigns
Website design and development
Digital advertising
Copywriting and content development
Strong project planning, estimating, budget management, and resource coordination skills.
Excellent written communication, attention to detail, organization, and proactive problem-solving abilities.
Experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Wrike, or similar project management software.
Proficiency with Google Workspace preferred. 

Assets
Experience estimating complex research or integrated marketing engagements.
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Project Management, or a related field.
Experience managing formal RFP submissions.

The Fine Print
Full-time, permanent opportunity reporting to the President of the company.
Primarily remote role.
Must have reliable high-speed internet and an appropriate remote work setup.
The role will be in the English language and requires someone who is a native English speaker.
Core office hours are 7:30 AM–4:30 PM MT.
Team members must have at least 4 hours of overlap with True Insight's business hours.
Compensation is competitive and based on experience in the range of $1, 200 - $1,700 CAD/month
, plus bonus for those who become eligible based on our bonus program.

Why True Insight Marketing?
True Insight Marketing is a research-driven strategy firm. Insight is not a department here — it is the backbone of how we help clients gain clarity, confidence, and competitive advantage.
Our work spans research and strategy through implementation, including brand identity, websites, creative campaigns, digital advertising, and ongoing growth initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to manage varied, meaningful projects while working with a highly experienced network of strategists, researchers, creatives, technical specialists, and partners.

– Learn our approach and continue building your integrated marketing and project management expertise.

– Thrive both professionally and personally.

The Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC) is a world-renowned biomedical and hospital research centre. Create and maintain a library of methodological resources, guidelines, standards, and templates.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager of Technical Development
new_jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

Program Manager of Technical Development

Position Location:

Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major US airport.

Job Summary

The Program Manager of Technical Development is responsible for the technical quality, standards, and capability of the Field Services workforce. This role ensures that commissioning execution is technically rigorous and consistent across all projects and sites — not dependent on the expertise of specific individuals — by developing field competency, owning technical standards and SOPs, and driving continuous improvement of processes and workflows.

The Program Manager of Technical Development partners directly with the Program Manager – Projects and Program Manager – People verticals and reports to the Associate Director, providing the technical input that informs staffing readiness, delivery risk, and training investment decisions across the program.

This role's primary objective is to ensure the technical execution of commissioning work is correct, consistent, and scalable across all Field Services programs, and to build a workforce technically capable of handling complex systems and abnormal conditions without dependency on a small group of senior experts.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Own Technical Standards and Processes (30%)

Develop, implement, and maintain commissioning SOPs, workflows, templates, and client programmatic requirements across all programs
Ensure consistent application of technical standards across all active projects and sites; monitor compliance and address deviations proactively
Own the technical onboarding process for new projects and programs: ensure workflows are integrated, client-specific requirements are documented, and field teams are trained prior to execution
Maintain a centralized, accessible repository of technical processes, deliverables, and field insights
Provide technical input on proposals and scope reviews to ensure execution approach, staffing qualifications, and deliverable commitments are technically sound

Develop Field Capability and Competency (25%)

Identify technical skill gaps across the workforce and develop structured plans to close them through training, mentoring, and field coaching
Deliver or coordinate onsite technical training, hands-on instruction, and real-time coaching during commissioning execution
Ensure the workforce develops depth in troubleshooting, system-level understanding, and abnormal condition response — not just procedural execution capability
Partner with Program Manager – People on development planning; provide technical competency input into promotion readiness calibration
Assess Technical Lead and SME performance; identify development needs and succession candidates within the technical track

Manage Technical Escalation and Field Oversight (20%)

Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues during commissioning and testing; resolve at the Program Manager of Technical Development level before escalating to the Associate Director
Provide direct technical oversight and support during critical project phases, high-risk testing activities, or complex system integrations
Ensure accuracy and technical rigor in testing documentation, commissioning plans, and reports
Audit technical deliverable quality across active projects; identify recurring issues and initiate root cause analysis and standards updates as needed
Conduct regular site visits to observe technical execution firsthand, validate standards compliance, and deliver field coaching

Drive Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Management (15%)

Capture lessons learned across projects and systematically incorporate findings into SOPs, workflows, and training content
Drive iterative improvement of technical processes — standards should become more efficient, scalable, and consistently adopted over time
Identify recurring technical execution gaps and develop programmatic responses rather than one-off interventions
Contribute to routine reporting by preparing the technical capability and standards compliance section for Associate Director review and compilation

Ensure Cross-Functional Alignment and Project Onboarding (10%)

Partner with Program Manager – Projects to ensure technical standards are applied in the field; provide early warning on technical gaps that may affect schedule, quality, or delivery risk
Partner with Program Manager – People to align training priorities with workforce readiness and communicate technical capability requirements that inform staffing and hiring decisions
Provide technical input to the Associate Director on capability gaps, workforce readiness, and technical risk posture across the program portfolio
Coordinate with the Associate Director of Technical Development on programmatic and departmental standardization and training initiatives

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (advanced Level For All The Following)

Deep technical expertise in electrical and/or mechanical commissioning systems
Demonstrated ability to develop and enforce technical standards at program scale
Experience developing SOPs, workflows, and technical process documentation
Advanced troubleshooting and system-level thinking capability
Strong training, mentoring, and technical knowledge-transfer capability
Ability to translate field observations into scalable process improvements
Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve standards development, training delivery, and technical documentation
Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth, distributed, remote environment
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues
Proficient in MS Office Suite and commissioning documentation tools
Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

Approximately 50% domestic travel; may include any or all 50 US states
Occasional international travel required based on program needs
Must reside near a major airport
Must hold a valid driver's license and ability to rent vehicles
Must hold or be able to obtain a valid REAL ID or passport for domestic air travel
Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field — or equivalent experience

PLUS

Minimum 8 years' experience in commissioning or mission-critical construction
Must hold or be able to obtain NFPA 70E and OSHA 30 certifications as required

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)

Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option

Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents

new_jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

How You Will Impact Skylo

Skylo is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to solve the complex challenge of synchronizing our cloud-native software evolution with global network implementation and hardware certification. You will be the primary driver behind the world’s first live direct-to-device satellite service, ensuring that code deployed in the cloud works flawlessly with physical infrastructure on the ground and partner devices in the field. This role is not just about tracking tasks; it is about navigating the technical trade-offs between rapid software iteration and the rigorous, long-lead requirements of satellite network operations. You will resolve the systemic ambiguity that arises when software, hardware, and vendors collide, ultimately ensuring that our global network scales reliably as we expand across five continents.

This role is located in Mountain View, California (On-Site)

How You Will Contribute

Drive the end-to-end integration of cloud-native software releases with physical network implementation across our global satellite ground stations.
Synchronize hardware development cycles with firmware and software milestones to ensure seamless device certification with OEM and chipset partners.
Navigate technical trade-offs between terrestrial roaming requirements and non-terrestrial network (NTN) performance standards.
Resolve systemic ambiguity between software engineering, network operations, and external satellite operators to maintain 99.9% service availability.
Define and track critical path dependencies for multi-continent network deployments, including regulatory and infrastructure milestones.
Partner across teams to clarify requirements and drive decisions on resource allocation during high-stakes launch windows.
Establish scalable post-launch retrospectives that transform operational bottlenecks into automated deployment workflows.
Manage high-leverage risks associated with global spectrum coordination and hardware supply chains to prevent project slippage.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field that provides a foundation in both software and hardware systems.
5+ years of experience managing complex engineering programs that integrate cloud-native software with physical infrastructure or telecommunications hardware.
Proven ability to synchronize the software development lifecycle (SDLC) with hardware testing and network deployment milestones.
Deep understanding of the technical constraints associated with network implementation, including spectrum coordination or ground station operations.
Experience navigating device certification processes and 3GPP standards in partnership with chipset makers or OEMs.
History of managing high-stakes vendor relationships and external satellite operator partnerships to hit critical launch dates.
Expertise in adapting agile software practices to fit the rigid, long-lead timelines of physical network infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated capability in using analytical skills to identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks across cross-functional engineering teams.
Experience applying sound judgment to balance rapid software iteration with the reliability requirements of a live global network.
Record of driving alignment between technical engineering requirements and non-technical business objectives in a fast-paced environment.
Expert level experience with program management tools such as JIRA

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we offer an attractive range of benefits:

Competitive compensation packages including a stock option-based equity program
Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plan
Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
A generous time-off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
A once-in-a-career opportunity to operate the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network
Access to a world-class team across software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite, and network virtualization
Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic, and South Asia characteristics

. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant training.

In addition to base salary, Skylo offers a competitive benefits package including health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and equity options.

General Matter enriches uranium.

We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.

Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.

Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society.

We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.

Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.

Ability to cut through ambiguous definitions and solve problems from first principles

new_jobs.title: Senior Acquisition Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
MTSI is seeking a Senior Acquisition Program Manager
to support an Air Force Life Cycle Management Center customer at Wright Patterson AFB. The customer Program Office is responsible for planning, developing, and acquiring cost-effective, long-term critical U.S. Air Force capabilities within an Integrated Product Team (IPT) structure.

The selected candidate will serve as a senior acquisition professional supporting program planning, execution, and oversight across the acquisition lifecycle. The candidate will work side by side with Government personnel and support contractors in the Program Office and will regularly interface with major defense contractors supporting critical defense capabilities.

This position requires a highly experienced program manager with strong defense acquisition expertise, the ability to lead and coordinate across functional teams, and the communication skills to support decisions at senior levels. Most work will be performed in the customer workspace. Travel up to 20% may be required.

Responsibilities

Duties include, but are not limited to:

Provide senior program management and acquisition support for Government development and execution efforts.
Lead or support planning, coordination, and execution of acquisition activities across the program lifecycle.
Work closely with program managers, engineers, contracting, financial management, logistics, test, and other functional teams to ensure integrated program execution.
Maintain situational awareness of day-to-day program issues and proactively plan for major program events, reviews, and decision points.
Support development, coordination, and staffing of acquisition documentation required by statute, regulation, and policy in support of program milestones and decision events.
Develop, review, and coordinate acquisition strategies, acquisition planning documents, milestone documentation, briefing materials, decision packages, and related program artifacts.
Support contract award and contract modification activities, including pre-award documentation, source selection support, and post-award execution support.
Review contractor deliverables, integrated master schedules, technical status reports, and cost performance reports, and provide assessments and recommendations to the Government team.
Monitor and assess contractor performance, including prime and subcontractor execution, and identify impacts to program cost, schedule, and performance.
Lead and facilitate IPT activities to synchronize cross-functional stakeholder efforts, resolve issues, and support timely decision-making.
Develop and communicate program roadmaps for capabilities, technologies, and product lines.
Develop integration and transition plans, procedures, and resource coordination necessary to support program execution and transition activities.
Support milestone planning, tracking, scheduling, staff coordination, and preparation of decision-quality documentation for senior leaders.
Identify program risks, issues, and opportunities; develop mitigation strategies; and communicate impacts and recommendations to leadership.
Prepare and present clear, accurate, and concise written and oral communications for senior Department of the Air Force, Department of War, and industry stakeholders.
Establish and maintain trusted working relationships with Government customers, contractors, and other stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Experience supporting Department of War acquisition programs, including contracting and program management activities across the acquisition lifecycle.
Experience developing and staffing acquisition and contracting documentation, such as Justification and Approval/Authority documents, acquisition strategy documentation, Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs), Statements of Objectives (SOOs), and Statements of Work (SOWs), particularly for research and development efforts.
Experience supporting milestone planning and the development, coordination, and staffing of statutory and regulatory documentation through completion.
Experience managing or assessing program execution with emphasis on cost, schedule, and performance.
Experience leading or operating within Integrated Product Teams and coordinating across multiple functional disciplines.
Strong knowledge of Federal acquisition processes and applicable acquisition and contracting regulations.
Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills, including the ability to prepare briefings, reports, and decision support materials for senior Government and military leaders.
Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment, define problems, develop courses of action, and coordinate effectively across Government and contractor teams.
Experience working on classified and/or special access programs.
Knowledge of Air Force Life Cycle Management Center frameworks, directives, and policies.
U.S. citizenship required due to contract requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as a Senior Defense Acquisition Program Manager supporting complex weapon system or enterprise-level acquisition efforts.
Experience with Major Defense Acquisition Programs (MDAPs) or similarly complex, highly visible defense acquisition efforts.
Experience developing and staffing documentation in support of acquisition milestones, program decision points, and senior-level reviews.
Experience briefing senior Department of the Air Force, Office of the Secretary of Defense, and other Department of War stakeholders.
Current knowledge of defense acquisition guidance, policy, and best practices.
Program management certification such as DAU, PMP, Agile, or equivalent.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management; Engineering, or other military studies related filed plus 18 years of relevant experience
OR
Master’s degree; Business, Project Management; Engineering, or other military studies related field plus 10 years of relevant experience
Project management certifications (e.g., DAU, PMP, Agile, or similar) Desired.

Clearance Requirements

Active Top Secret clearance with SCI and SAP eligibility.

Please Note

This position requires U.S. citizenship due to contract requirements.
Travel up to 20% may be required.
