new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The People & Business Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating, managing, and optimizing internal operations across business units, ensuring operational efficiency, organizational alignment, and business performance.
Reporting directly to the Head of Business, this role drives operational effectiveness through three key pillars: People, Systems, and Financial Performance.
Acting as a central operational partner to business leaders and corporate functions, the role translates business priorities into structured execution, monitors performance, strengthens internal processes, and enables teams to operate efficiently as the business grows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Business & Organizational Operations
Manage and coordinate day-to-day internal operations across business units, ensuring alignment with business priorities, timelines, and approved budgets.
Establish and maintain operational workflows, reporting structures, approval processes, and cross-functional coordination mechanisms.
Lead weekly and monthly operational reviews, track action items, identify bottlenecks, and follow through on issue resolution.
Coordinate with business leaders and corporate functions, including Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Project Management, to ensure efficient execution and accountability.
Monitor organizational workload, operational capacity, and resource utilization; identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
Support the Head of Business in translating management decisions into actionable plans with clear ownership, timelines, and expected outcomes.

2. People Operations & Organizational Effectiveness
Coordinate annual and quarterly workforce planning, including headcount requirements, recruitment priorities, and personnel budget tracking.
Partner with Corporate HR and business leaders on recruitment planning, onboarding, performance reviews, and employee development initiatives.
Maintain organizational structures, job descriptions, role responsibilities, and reporting lines to ensure clarity and accountability.
Coordinate performance management cycles, consolidate evaluation results, and follow up on agreed development actions.
Identify people-related operational challenges and recommend improvements in team structure, workload allocation, and collaboration.
Support internal communication, employee engagement, and culture-building initiatives in collaboration with Corporate HR.

3. Business & Financial Performance Management
Work closely with Finance and business leaders to coordinate annual operating plans (AOP), business budgets, and periodic financial forecasts.
Monitor business performance against approved targets, including revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, and personnel costs.
Prepare monthly and quarterly business performance reports, highlighting budget variances, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
Track cost efficiency, resource utilization, and productivity across business units.
Coordinate financial and operational data reconciliation, ensuring timely and accurate management reporting.
Provide business insights and recommendations to support leadership in resource allocation, cost optimization, and operational decision-making.

4. Systems, Processes & Governance
Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve internal SOPs, workflows, approval matrices, and reporting standards.
Ensure operational compliance with approved corporate policies and internal governance requirements.
Coordinate with Finance, HR, Legal, and Procurement to address compliance requirements, operational risks, and documentation.
Maintain centralized management dashboards and tracking systems to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Identify opportunities for workflow automation, data integration, and digital tools to improve operational productivity.
Drive process adoption and ensure consistent implementation across business units.

5. Cross-Functional Alignment & Operational Improvement
Act as a key coordination point between business units and corporate functions.
Translate strategic priorities from the Head of Business into measurable operational initiatives.
Monitor the implementation of organizational changes, new operating models, and internal improvement projects.
Proactively identify operational gaps, dependencies, and risks; propose solutions and escalate critical decisions when needed.
Support business growth and new initiatives through operational planning, resource coordination, and process readiness.

KEY DELIVERABLES

Operational Management Framework: Standardized workflows, SOPs, approval processes, and reporting mechanisms across business units.
People & Workforce Plan: Consolidated headcount planning, personnel budget tracking, organizational structures, and performance review coordination.
Business Performance Reporting: Monthly and quarterly dashboards covering revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, budget variances, and business performance.
Management & Execution Tracking: Clear action ownership, progress monitoring, issue escalation, and follow-up from operational reviews.
Operational Improvement: Measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, reporting accuracy, resource utilization, and cross-functional collaboration.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience & Technical Skills
5–8 years of experience in business operations, organizational operations, business planning, or similar functions, with at least 2 years in a managerial or team leadership capacity.
Experience working across multiple business units, preferably within media, entertainment, creative services, technology, or other high-growth environments.
Strong understanding of operational budgeting, P&L monitoring, cost control, workforce planning, and performance reporting.
Proven experience in establishing SOPs, coordinating cross-functional workflows, and improving operational processes.
Strong analytical capabilities, proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, and familiarity with project management and reporting tools.
Experience working closely with Finance, HR, and business leadership teams.
Good command of Vietnamese and English, both written and spoken.

Core Competencies
Business Acumen: Understands how operational activities impact financial performance and business results.
Structured Execution: Translates complex priorities into clear plans, processes, and measurable outcomes.
Analytical Thinking: Uses data to identify gaps, evaluate performance, and recommend improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works effectively across different teams, functions, and leadership levels.
Ownership & Accountability: Proactively follows through on commitments and drives issues toward resolution.
Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Brings structure to dynamic environments without compromising flexibility.
People-Oriented Leadership: Supports team effectiveness, constructive communication, and organizational development.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

A hands-on business operations professional who combines structured thinking, financial discipline, people awareness, and strong execution capabilities.
Someone who understands the dynamics of a growing business, brings clarity to complex operations, and helps leadership build a more efficient, accountable, and scalable organization.
Thinks like a business partner, operates with discipline, and drives execution with ownership.

Administration & Office Management
Business Reporting / Performance Analyst

Functional Collaboration (non-direct reporting):
Corporate Finance & Accounting
Corporate HR / People Operations
Legal & Procurement
Business Unit Leads / Heads
Project Management / PMO

new_jobs.title: Product Strategist | Digital Products & AI
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.

We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport.

Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.

PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life

Job Description

This practice is built for the way enterprise software actually gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses.

As a Product Strategist, you'll help clients identify which problems are worth solving and shape products that deliver measurable value. Working alongside AI Engineers and Data Engineers, you'll take opportunities from discovery through adoption, combining deep business understanding with a practical view of what technology can achieve. The person defining the product is also accountable for whether it gets used, which means you'll stay close to the outcome long after launch.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. AI agents are changing how products are built, but they cannot decide what should be built in the first place. You'll work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and help clients move from broad ambitions to solutions that create lasting impact.

As part of the Digital Products & AI team, you can expect to:

Lead discovery with clients to understand how work gets done, where value is being lost, and which opportunities are worth pursuing.
Define product requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and success measures that guide delivery and enable measurable outcomes.
Translate business challenges into products, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent workflows that people will trust and adopt.
Shape how AI capabilities are applied, including what should be automated, where human oversight is required, and how success should be evaluated.
Drive adoption by aligning stakeholders, supporting change, and helping clients redesign processes where necessary to realize value.
Create reusable approaches, assets, and industry insights that strengthen future engagements, with the strongest ideas becoming capabilities and offerings we take to market.

Qualifications

You have a track record of defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions that create measurable business outcomes. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work.

To be successful, you'll have:

Product and strategy foundations

Experience in product management, product strategy, consulting, or a similar role focused on defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions.
Experience leading discovery, shaping product direction, and translating complex business challenges into actionable plans.
Experience building business cases, defining success measures, and demonstrating value realization.

Industry and AI understanding

Deep expertise in at least one industry sector, with the ability to quickly establish credibility with both operational and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of AI-enabled products, including agents, retrieval approaches, automation, and the opportunities and limitations of modern AI systems.
Experience evaluating competing opportunities and making informed decisions about where technology can create the greatest impact.

Enterprise delivery

Experience working with multidisciplinary teams to deliver technology solutions from concept through implementation and adoption.
Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence decisions across multiple levels of an organization.
Commercial judgment and the ability to balance business value, user needs, technical feasibility, and delivery constraints.

Ideally, you'll also bring:

Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or a leadership role within your industry.
Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries.
Experience with change management, operating model design, process transformation, or driving adoption of new technologies.
Experience using data, analytics, AI tools, SQL, Python, or similar approaches to support decision-making and product strategy.

Additional Information

Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site

Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work.

Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self.

What makes this a great opportunity?

The Assistant Innovation Project Manager role supports the development and delivery of consumer-led innovation opportunities, translating consumer needs and market opportunities into compelling, commercially viable propositions that strengthen the brand portfolio and deliver incremental growth. It also supports and owns defined innovation projects or workstreams under the guidance of the Head of Innovation, Senior Innovation Manager and Innovation Manager connecting cross-functional expertise from opportunity development through launch and post-launch learning.

Role Responsibilities

Innovation pipeline and project delivery

Support and own defined innovation projects and workstreams, coordinating day-to-day delivery, milestones, dependencies, risks and decision points from concept through launch and post-launch optimisation.
Support preparation of project briefs, status updates, gate materials and recommendations to support timely, evidence-based decisions.
Work across near-term launch delivery and longer-term opportunity development, escalating material changes to scope, cost, timing or proposition.

Consumer-led opportunity and proposition development

Partner with Consumer Insights and Brand teams to translate research, market trends and unmet consumer needs into clear opportunity briefs and testable propositions.
Support concept development, product and pack proposition refinement, consumer testing and synthesis of learning into recommended next steps.
Ensure propositions are aligned with brand strategy, portfolio priorities and intended consumer and customer needs.

Cross-functional orchestration

Support the coordination of cross-functional innovation projects with R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, Insights, Brand, Sales and Shopper experts; establish clear workstream accountabilities, deliverables and dependencies.
Partner with functional experts who lead their respective disciplines, while maintaining visibility of progress, risks and implications for the overall consumer proposition and commercial objectives.
Support and facilitate project meetings focused on decisions, learning, risks and next actions; maintain clear records of agreed actions and ownership.

Commercialisation, governance and launch readiness

Develop and consolidate business-case inputs, including opportunity sizing, volume, pricing, margin and growth potential, in partnership with Finance, Insights and Commercial experts who own their specialist assumptions.
Coordinate governance requirements and stage-gate submissions, maintaining accurate project information in agreed systems and tools (Planisware).
Partner with Brand and customer-facing teams on launch handovers and readiness, without replacing functional ownership of go-to-market execution.

Performance and continuous improvement

Support the definition and tracking of project success measures, including consumer validation, launch readiness and post-launch performance.
Coordinate post-launch reviews, document insights and recommended improvements, and apply learning to future pipeline decisions.
Identify practical improvements to templates, routines and ways of working that make innovation delivery simpler and more effective. Contribute to longer-term pipeline development and innovation and go-to-market capability building.
Support Innovation team operations, including project investment and budget tracking, Buywise purchase order management, expenditure reporting and coordination of administrative processes to enable effective project delivery and financial governance.

Qualifications

Experience and capabilities

Experience in brand management, marketing, innovation, commercial or project coordination within FMCG or a related consumer-led industry.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, organise project plans and follow through on actions and deadlines.
Commercial curiosity and comfort working with basic business cases, consumer research and performance measures.
Strong collaboration, communication and influencing skills; confidence working with functional specialists.
Structured problem-solving, attention to detail, learning agility and willingness to constructively challenge assumptions.
Relevant tertiary qualification in marketing, business or a related discipline desirable, or equivalent practical experience.

Measures of success

Assigned project milestones, governance deliverables and decisions are prepared on time and to an agreed standard.
Clear ownership of workstreams, transparent risks and timely escalation of material trade-offs.
Consumer and commercial evidence is reflected in project recommendations.
Effective collaboration with Brand and functional experts; smooth handovers to launch owners.
Post-launch learning is captured and translated into practical actions.

new_jobs.description:
Summary

Employee will be assigned to Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Service (PMRS) - VA Healthcare System - Lexington - KY. This position will provide leadership in strategic administrative planning - resource allocation - performance improvement - and oversight of daily operations. This position requires a mastery of qualitative and quantitative methods for assessing program effectiveness and complex management systems.

Qualifications

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must also have at least one (1) year of specialized experience that equipped them with the particular knowledge - skills - and abilities to perform successfully the duties of this position. To be creditable - this experience must have been equivalent to at least the GS-11 level in the Federal service. Specialized experience includes: designing and conducting studies - analyzing findings - and making recommendations regarding the efficiency of clinical systems; utilizing qualitative and quantitative analytical techniques to measure the effectiveness of programs; analyzing the impact of new legislation - directives - or standards; managing resources; developing internal policies; and resolving complex administrative problems. Physical Requirements: Work is primarily sedentary - although some slight physical effort may be required such as standing - walking - bending - or carrying light items. For more information on these qualification standards - please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/. Your experience must be fully documented on your resume and must include job title - duties - month and year start/end dates AND hours worked per week. A full year of work is considered to be 35-40 hours of work per week. Part-time experience will be credited on the basis of time actually spent in appropriate activities. Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must indicate clearly the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment. IN DESCRIBING YOUR EXPERIENCE - PLEASE BE CLEAR AND SPECIFIC. WE WILL NOT MAKE ASSUMPTIONS REGARDING YOUR EXPERIENCE. Overstating your qualifications and/or experience in your application materials or application questionnaire may result in your removal from consideration. Cheating on the online assessment may also result in your removal from consideration.

Duties

***THIS IS NOT A VIRTUAL POSITION - YOU MUST LIVE WITHIN OR BE WILLING TO RELOCATE WITHIN A COMMUTABLE DISTANCE OF THE DUTY LOCATION*** Duties include but may not be limited to the following: Serves as the senior management analyst responsible for the comprehensive evaluation of PMRS program effectiveness
Applies advanced management and organizational principles to analyze the administrative health of the service
Supports regional rehabilitation programs within the current organizational structure
Designs and conducts complex management studies to resolve substantive problems in health care delivery
Analyzes interrelated issues of effectiveness - efficiency - and productivity to develop authoritative recommendations for organizational restructuring - workflow re-engineering - and resource reallocation
Utilizes advanced qualitative and quantitative techniques to mine and interpret data from organizational sources
Identifies long-term trends in workload - acuity - and costs to forecast future program requirements (3-5 years out)
Evaluates the impact of new or proposed legislation - directives - and accreditation standards on PMRS operations
Develops new administrative criteria and internal policies to ensure compliance and optimize program performance where national guidelines are vague or require extensive adaptation
Develops and implements standardized performance metrics to measure the quality and timeliness of administrative support services - ensuring alignment with the medical center's strategic goals
Manages and oversees all PMRS resources - including financial - personnel - and equipment
Develops long-range program plans - goals - and objectives with significant impact on PMRS and potentially the larger organization and presents these plans to leadership
Approves expenditures for all non-recurring items - ensuring they align with budget priorities
Reviews proposed legislation or regulations that would significantly change the administrative processes and procedures of service programs and clinics and makes recommendations
Makes recommendations on how to implement broad regulatory guidelines and develops administrative norms and procedures for the allocation and distribution of resources across the service
Represents PMRS at high-level meetings and committees - making decisions on behalf of the service and serving as a key advisor to executive leadership
Performs supervisory and team leadership functions as part of operational responsibilities to include: develops performance plans and standards - providing regular feedback
and identifies professional development and training needs and facilitates opportunities for growth
Performs other related duties as assigned
Work Schedule: Monday - Friday - 8:00am - 4:30pm
Recruitment & Relocation Incentives: Not authorized Telework: This position may be authorized for Ad-hoc telework
Telework eligibility will be discussed during the interview process
NOTE: The facility prefers those with experience in management roles such as supervisory - managerial - or executive positions involving coordination or oversight of programs - people or teams.

new_jobs.title: Corporate Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana's Corporate Strategy team is a small, collaborative and goal-focused group that works with senior leadership to establish the future course for Humana. In Corporate Strategy, you will identify and analyze growth opportunities and work with business leaders to prioritize options and set the long-term strategy agenda. The team has frequent interactions with Humana's CEO and manages deliverables for Humana's broader Executive Leadership Team and Board of Directors. Our team also undertakes internal consulting engagements across different topics.

The Corporate Strategy Analyst role is modeled after top-tier management consultancies. Daily activities will include developing industry analyses, building high-level financial or other business models, conducting qualitative analyses and synthesizing findings to create executive-level deliverables and recommendations for Humana's senior leaders. Examples of project work include identifying and evaluating growth opportunities across our lines of business. They also include developing market and competitive strategies, assessing partnership and acquisition opportunities, designing operating model / organizational improvements, and supporting pilots / innovation opportunities for various business leaders.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct market research, competitive analyses, and quantitative modeling to support strategic initiatives and business planning efforts
Gather, analyze, and synthesize internal and external data into actionable insights for executive decision-making
Convert strategy into roadmaps, business cases and projects while prioritizing timelines and ensuring alignment and execution
Develop presentations and executive-level materials
Collaborate with Corporate Strategy colleagues, and contribute to a high-performing, inclusive, and supportive team environment

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's degree
1+ years of full-time work experience in strategy consulting or corporate/business unit strategy
Analytical skills (ex: quantitative analysis and research, financial modeling)
Conceptual skills (ex: translating ambiguous problem statements into structured frameworks, generating hypotheses independently and testing them, synthesizing complex information into digestible executive insights, managing cross-functional stakeholders)

Preferred Qualifications

Passion for Humana's focus on value-based healthcare for seniors
Exposure to the healthcare industry

Location:
Working locations are primarily Louisville, KY, and Arlington, VA (Washington, DC metro area); also open to candidates living in or willing to relocate to Chicago or Nashville. The Strategy team operates on a hybrid schedule with an expectation of 2 to 3 in‑office days per week. Relocation assistance available.

Travel:
Occasional travel to Humana offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

$86,200 - $118,600 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. new_jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst - Insights + Analytics, True Global Intelligence
new_jobs.description:
Agency

FleishmanHillard

Job Function

Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction

Data Science and Analytics

Overview

Job Description:

FleishmanHillard, a global communications agency, has an immediate opening for a  Senior Research Analyst
to join our global research and intelligence practice, branded as TRUE Global Intelligence (TGI). Location is flexible and candidates will be considered from the Seattle, Los Angeles or San Francisco greater metro areas
. FleishmanHillard’s TRUE Global Intelligence practice serves as a strategic enabler to the broader organization by harnessing research and data-driven insights to achieve client business objectives. Our work within TRUE Global Intelligence integrates measurement, primary research and secondary research methods with advanced data analytics and strategic consulting.

This position will assist with analyzing and synthesizing data to provide actionable insights and tactical recommendations for the agency’s clients and will be a great opportunity for someone who is interested in PR measurement.

This position will be fully embedded in an exciting, household name client monitoring brand reputation across corporate, consumer and issues workstreams. This person will actively track cultural trends  - and should have a deep understanding of US culture - and signals for proactive media opportunities and activations while identifying emerging reputational and business risks from across the media ecosystem. The role will also contribute to performance measurement reporting and audience insight work. This will be a great opportunity for someone who is already experimenting with AI in a range of research and insights use cases to embed use AI platforms and workflows into your daily routine.

FleishmanHillard, globally headquartered in St. Louis, is one of the largest integrated communications companies in the world. Our service to clients draws on expertise across more than 25 disciplines, including B2C and B2B marketing, branding, corporate reputation management, CSR, creative services, entertainment and sports, digital and social media, financial communications and investor relations, healthcare, internal communications, issues and crisis management, public affairs, and technology. FleishmanHillard believes a diverse team brings a wider range of personal and professional experiences and perspectives.

We recognize that diversity, equity and inclusion benefit our agency, our clients, and the communities in which we work and live. To that end, we strongly encourage applications from women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ community, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

Responsibilities

Participate in integrated research and analytics assignments, which include social and traditional media monitoring, audience analysis, measurement, primary research and use of secondary methodologies.
Actively monitor online conversation around client brands to proactively identify issues, risks and opportunities
Analyze data, draft reports, and collaborate with team members to contribute findings to client discussions and presentations.
Manage the collection, cleaning, and synthesis of data from multiple sources.
Develop and report on KPIs, dashboards and scorecards.
Conduct secondary research and collaborate on research briefs to inform clients and communications teams on a variety of industries.
Recommend communications-centric solutions based on the research results.
Stay current with the latest measurement trends, as well as relevant industry trends.

Qualifications

Ability to join us in a hybrid model of working in-person in the Los Angeleas, San Francisco, or Seattle office weekly.
1 to 2+ years of experience working across a broad range of research categories and models; experience in secondary research. Preferably experience working in an advertising, digital, PR or research agency.
Proven analytical and deductive reasoning skills; able to translate findings into meaningful insights.
Ability to quickly spot patterns and surface actionable insights; separate signal from noise.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively communicate insights to internal and external communications stakeholders.
Comfortable working in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience writing boolean queries and using tools to analyze traditional and social media coverage, including Talkwalker, MuckRack, Facebook Insights, Twitter Analytics, etc.
Collaborative attitude, strong work ethic and ability to thrive and excel in a challenging fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with leveraging AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, CoPilot, etc) as part of daily ways of working

Our Story

We’re more motivated by what we can give than what we receive. That holds true for our colleagues, clients and communities across cultures and time zones. We believe giving our best is only possible in an environment that empowers us to truly be our best, so we focus on creating belonging for all and caring for the whole person. Because when you belong and have what you need to thrive — both at work and in life — you’re free to be you. To pursue your dreams and passions. To be bold and try new things, in the name of personal and professional growth and of work that leads to meaningful progress for the world. So, we respect and support one another amid differences and we acknowledge and celebrate who each of us is. We accept that we don't all have to have the same perspectives, beliefs, background or experiences to do great things together. A combination of our employee experience, industry-leading client work, global community service and contributions to inclusion has earned FleishmanHillard recognition as 2021, 2022 and 2023 Campaign Global PR Agency of the Year; 2023 ICCO Large Agency of the Year – The Americas; 2022 and 2023 PRWeek U.S. Agency of the Year; 2022 and 2023 PRWeek U.S. Outstanding Extra-Large Agency of the Year; 2023 Campaign US PR Agency of the Year; 2021 PRovoke APAC Consultancy of the Year; and 2021 PRWeek UK Large Consultancy of the Year. FleishmanHillard is part of Omnicom PR Group and has nearly 80 offices in more than 30 countries, plus affiliates in 45 countries.

FleishmanHillard offers a hybrid work model and seeks employees who are comfortable working in the office for a portion of their week, in accordance with their local office hybrid work policy. We value the collaboration and camaraderie that in-person interactions provide, but also understand the importance of flexibility and balance in our employees’ lives. We acknowledge that our people are diverse individuals with unique circumstances and needs, and therefore our goal is to foster a productive and inclusive work environment where all employees can thrive, both in and out of the office.

FleishmanHillard is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sex stereotyping, pregnancy (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, ancestry, medical condition, marital status, military or veteran status, alienage, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other protected class under federal, state or local laws. Please do not contact the office directly to apply – only resumes submitted through this website will be considered. If you need assistance reviewing career opportunities or completing an application, please email our careers team or call 314-982-1700 and ask to be connected to Talent Development.

The anticipated salary range for the Senior Research Analyst level is $54,000-$68,000.

Salary is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications and geography. A range of medical, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, paid time off and/or other benefits also are available.

The anticipated salary range for the Senior Research Analyst level is $54,000-$68,000.

To the extent permissible by local law, Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice

new_jobs.title: VBT Task Author-AI Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Hello,

Greetings from ZettaMine!!!

Freelancing Opportunity:
We are hiring VBT Task Authors
for a short-term AI Research, Benchmark Task Creation, and Red-Teaming
project focused on evaluating and identifying weaknesses in advanced AI models.
Eligible Locations:
Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Egypt, Ghana, Nigeria, Turkey, Brazil, and Colombia.

Role:
VBT Task Author-AI Research Analyst
Experience:
3+ Years preferred
Mode:
Remote
Commitment:
Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (20 hours/week)
Working Hours:
Minimum 4 hours of overlap with PST working hours.

Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

Technical Qualification:

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative research skills.
Intermediate-to-advanced web research and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) capabilities.
Ability to discover hard-to-find facts using academic archives, public records, local databases, and other reliable sources.
Experience in fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, investigative research, or technical quality assurance.
Familiarity with AI benchmarks such as GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE).
Ability to write clear, precise, and unambiguous research prompts with evidence-backed answer keys.
Strong attention to detail when verifying sources, identifying contradictions, and documenting source URLs.
Ability to analyze AI model outputs, search logs, and research trajectories to identify errors and reasoning weaknesses.

Educational Qualification:

Mandatory:
Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant engineering domain.
Strong research, technical analysis, and documentation skills are preferred.

Experience:

Experience in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task creation, red-teaming, or technical QA review is preferred.
Prior experience designing challenging research tasks that expose weaknesses in advanced AI models is an advantage.
Familiarity with AI model evaluation frameworks and benchmark testing is beneficial.

Availability:

Full-time commitment of 40 hours per week
or part-time commitment of 20 hours per week
.
Minimum 4 hours of overlap with PST working hours
.
Ability to complete assigned research and benchmark tasks within the project timelines.
Availability for the full 4-week engagement
.

Others:

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Strong written communication and documentation skills.
Ability to validate information using primary or highly credible sources.
Experience with prompt-injection or reasoning-trap tasks is an advantage.
Prior experience as a benchmark reviewer, auditor, or quality lead is preferred.
Reliable computer/laptop and stable internet connection.

What You’ll Work On

Research niche topics to discover difficult-to-find facts that challenge advanced AI models.
Verify factual information using primary sources and credible references.
Develop clear, evidence-based benchmark tasks designed to test AI research and reasoning capabilities.
Create precise answer keys supported by reliable evidence and exact source URLs.
Test benchmark tasks against designated state-of-the-art AI models to identify potential weaknesses.
Analyze model outputs, search logs, and intermediate results to determine where and why failures occur.
Distinguish genuine model limitations from ambiguous prompts or insufficient evidence.
Identify recurring failure patterns and apply them across different research domains.
Review tasks created by other contributors to ensure accuracy, clarity, and quality.
Maintain consistent documentation and follow project evaluation guidelines.

Perks of Freelancing

Fully remote work environment.
Flexible full-time or part-time commitment.
Opportunity to contribute to advanced AI training and evaluation projects.
Hands-on experience with AI benchmarking, investigative research, and red-teaming.
Opportunity to help improve the research and reasoning capabilities of next-generation AI models.

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV with us at
md.afreen@zettamine.com

Thanks & Regards,

Saranya M (Afreen)

ZettaMine

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Integrity team is dedicated to safeguarding our users on Grab. We are building a centralized, unified Risk and Compliance technology platform using Grab's proven risk and compliance tech, GrabDefence. We use our datasets and advanced AI capabilities to address critical challenges, from ensuring safety and preventing fraud to achieving regulatory compliance. We are involved in the entire data lifecycle, including analyzing user behavior, identifying financial crime anomalies, and developing detection and prevention modules across user onboarding and transaction journeys.

Get to Know the Role

Reporting to the Senior Analytics Manager in the Integrity team, you will be a key analytics partner in operationalizing the Unified Risk Platform that manages risk across the Grab Ecosystem. You will conduct deep-dive analysis on user behaviors, product funnels, and transaction patterns to identify potential risks and new fraud typologies on our partner platforms. Your data-driven insights will directly guide the design of risk detection strategies, the optimization of shared AI/Machine Learning models, and the implementation of crucial risk controls to safeguard a diverse user base from multiple types of fraud and financial crime.

This role is based onsite in our Petaling Jaya office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will be the subject matter expert in using data to analyze fraud loss, business/product performance, and the effectiveness of risk controls across different Grab business verticals.
You will lead the identification of new fraud and risk patterns, developing data-driven rules and strategies to address potential risks using advanced methods like Graph-Based Detection.
You will conduct statistical analyses to ensure the accuracy and efficiency of detection systems, maintaining data and rule integrity.
You will architect automated self-serve capabilities for stakeholders to monitor key risk metrics, attack patterns, and the efficiency of fraud/AML detection systems.
You will collaborate with Grab business teams to support data extractions, audits, and compliance requirements, ensuring all necessary data is provided for assessments.
You will conduct experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of risk controls and recommend improvements based on findings.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

At least 4 years of experience in data-related or quantitative fields.
A Bachelor's Degree in disciplines such as Analytics, Statistics, Software, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering.
Proficiency in SQL, Presto, ETL, Power BI, Python, and Excel.
Experience with the application of experimentation and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, probability distributions, regression, decision trees).
Intermediate understanding and early hands-on exposure towards Gen AI/LLM's including prompt engineering, query optimization, automated insight generation
Proficiency in Feature Engineering (SQL, Spark) to build data inputs for models, with a clear focus on data utility and feature logic rather than data pipeline ownership.
Desirable: Understanding of the risk management, fraud and compliance space (e.g. AML, eKYC) in digital ecosystems

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

About The Role

The Data Analyst
is responsible for developing and implementing the organisation’s data, reporting and health intelligence functions to support evidence-based decision-making, advocacy, research, evaluation and continuous improvement.

You’ll analyse data from population health, government, Aboriginal health, survey and program sources, applying data analytics, epidemiology and population health principles to identify trends, monitor outcomes and inform strategy.

Working across the organisation and with external stakeholders, you’ll develop dashboards, reports, indicators and evidence products that support Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Services, Closing the Gap priorities and improved health outcomes.

The role also promotes strong data governance, quality, integrity and Aboriginal Data Sovereignty, while building organisational capability in using data and evidence.

Responsibilities

Data & Governance

Develop and maintain data frameworks, governance, standards and processes that support data quality, integrity and effective use.
Establish secure systems for data collection, storage, management and reporting.

Health Intelligence & Analysis

Analyse population health, service utilisation and outcome data to identify trends, disparities, risks and emerging issues.
Apply epidemiological methods to support health surveillance, evidence briefs and Closing the Gap monitoring.

Data Management & Reporting

Source, extract, clean, validate and integrate data from government, population health and sector datasets, working with data custodians as required.
Develop dashboards, reports, scorecards and visualisations using Power BI and related tools to communicate insights clearly.
Maintain secure storage systems, data dictionaries, metadata and documentation.

Research, Evaluation & Stakeholder Support

Support research and evaluation through data analysis, collection tools, performance measures and outcome reporting.
Work with internal teams and stakeholders to identify data needs, provide advice and present findings clearly.

Continuous Improvement

Identify improvements to data systems, reporting and analytical approaches, keeping informed of emerging trends and best practice.
Contribute to organisational planning, continuous improvement and data capability.

Essential Criteria

Qualifications & Experience:

Tertiary qualification in Data Analytics, Statistics, Public Health, Information Management, Research, Economics or a related field.
Demonstrated experience in data analysis, reporting and visualisation, including working with large and multiple datasets.
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SQL and R or similar analytical/statistical tools.
Experience in health, community services, research or Aboriginal health is desirable.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, information management and data quality principles.
Understanding of, and commitment to, Aboriginal Community Controlled Health principles and values.
Able to obtain a National Police Check and current Working with Children Check.

Skills & Knowledge

Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills.
Ability to source, clean, manage and analyse complex datasets with a high level of accuracy.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.
Able to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and team-oriented, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their suitability for the role to talent@ahmrc.org.au
. Please include “Data Analyst” in the subject line.

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer/Project Manager based in the United States.

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer/Project Manager, you will lead the design and delivery of complex mechanical systems for mission-critical facilities and building projects.

You will oversee engineering activities from early design through construction documentation, ensuring technical excellence, code compliance, and alignment with project objectives.

Working with multidisciplinary teams, clients, vendors, and contractors, you will develop practical solutions that meet demanding performance and reliability requirements.

Your expertise will help shape mechanical infrastructure for critical environments, including data centers, telecommunications facilities, and other specialized buildings.

You will combine advanced mechanical design knowledge with project management, quality assurance, and technical leadership across multiple concurrent projects.

This role offers the flexibility of remote work while requiring occasional site visits and in-person client meetings in California and other relevant locations.

You will also mentor engineering and design professionals, manage project resources, and help deliver high-quality outcomes within established budgets and schedules.

Accountabilities

You will lead mechanical engineering design and project delivery, ensuring that technical solutions meet client requirements, applicable codes, quality standards, and project constraints. Your responsibilities will include:

Lead mechanical design: Develop, review, and coordinate mechanical systems and CAD drawings throughout schematic design (SD), design development (DD), and construction documentation (CD) phases.
Manage project delivery: Coordinate multiple projects, establish work plans, monitor deliverables, manage budgeted hours, and ensure milestones are achieved on schedule.
Develop engineering documentation: Prepare and review load calculations, specifications, scope-of-work narratives, basis-of-design documents, studies, reports, sketches, and other technical deliverables.
Design mechanical systems: Apply expertise in chilled water (CHW), hot water (HW), condenser water, steam, water-source heat pumps, variable- and constant-flow systems, and other building HVAC applications.
Select and evaluate equipment: Perform advanced equipment selection and analysis for chillers, boilers, cooling towers, air terminals, air valves, heat filters, direct-expansion (DX) equipment, fans, coils, and water-source heat pumps.
Apply HVAC engineering principles: Design and evaluate air-side systems, including constant-volume (CV) and variable-air-volume (VAV) systems, as well as hydronic systems and associated equipment.
Analyze building performance: Apply psychrometric principles, total-energy concepts, and an understanding of humid-climate design risks to develop effective mechanical solutions.
Ensure code compliance: Interpret and apply relevant building and mechanical codes, review code-related design elements, and ensure documentation meets regulatory and project requirements.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams: Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, and structural professionals, as well as project coordinators, project managers, clients, and vendors.
Resolve construction issues: Respond to requests for information (RFIs), review submittals, address installation challenges, and manage revisions, including architect's supplemental instructions (ASIs), using established documentation conventions.
Maintain quality and manage risk: Conduct quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) reviews of calculations, drawings, and specifications while applying risk management practices to protect project and client interests.
Provide technical leadership: Direct and mentor designers, establish drawing and specification requirements, review their work, and provide guidance to maintain high engineering and quality standards.
Manage project resources: Develop and monitor work plans in coordination with other project managers, ensuring that design scope, documentation, staffing, and available hours remain aligned.
Support client relationships: Participate in client meetings and vendor discussions, clarify technical requirements, and help deliver project objectives through effective communication and coordination.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced mechanical engineer with strong project management capabilities, advanced building systems knowledge, and the leadership skills needed to deliver technically demanding projects. You should bring:

At least 10 years of experience in mechanical design and/or project management.
A degree in engineering and a valid Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Demonstrated experience in building design and mechanical engineering for complex facilities.
Strong technical proficiency in CAD drawings, engineering calculations, mechanical specifications, and design documentation.
Extensive knowledge of applicable building and mechanical codes and the ability to ensure compliance throughout the design process.
Advanced understanding of HVAC systems, including chilled and hot water systems, hydronic systems, air-side systems, variable- and constant-flow applications, and water-source heat pumps.
Experience with equipment sizing, selection, scheduling, and performance analysis for a range of mechanical and HVAC equipment.
A thorough understanding of psychrometrics, humid-climate design risks, and total-energy concepts.
Strong project planning and management skills, including budget control, resource allocation, schedule management, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects.
Experience reviewing calculations and technical documentation, performing QA/QC, resolving installation issues, and responding to RFIs and submittals.
Proven leadership, mentoring, communication, and multidisciplinary coordination skills.
The ability to work effectively with clients, vendors, contractors, and internal engineering teams.
Experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, or the telecommunications industry is preferred.
Flexibility to work remotely while attending site visits and in-person client meetings as project requirements dictate.

Benefits

Annual salary: $150,000–$170,000, with actual compensation depending on skills, experience, certifications, and work location.
Remote work flexibility: The role offers remote work options, with site visits and in-person client meetings required as needed.
Mission-critical projects: The opportunity to contribute to complex mechanical engineering projects for a major Fortune 500 client.
Technical leadership: The opportunity to lead design activities, mentor engineering professionals, and influence project quality and delivery.
Collaborative environment: Work with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams on challenging building systems projects.
Referral bonus: A $5,000 referral bonus is advertised in the original posting; eligibility and conditions were not specified.

Location: Morristown, NJ

About The Job

The Customer Experience (CX) Program Manager enables and supports partners in the Sanofi NA Vaccines business to advance customer experience strategies. Reporting directly to the Director, Customer Centricity, this role serves as the operational engine behind our CX vision, translating strategy into structured programs, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and ensuring seamless cross-functional coordination across the organization.

This is an ideal role for someone who thrives at the intersection of process excellence, data-driven execution, and stakeholder engagement someone who can bring structure to ambiguity and rally diverse teams around a shared customer-first mission.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI-driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, youll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

About Sanofi

Were an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving peoples lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives.

Main Responsibilities

Continuous Improvement & Process Excellence

Apply Continuous Improvement methodologies to identify, prioritize, and eliminate friction points across the customer journey

Lead root cause analysis on key customer pain points and design scalable, efficient process improvements

Execute CX improvement initiatives aligned to the NA Vaccines CX roadmap, tracking progress from implementation through impact measurement

Reduce defects and inefficiencies in Moments that Matter, leveraging automation and technology where appropriate

Deliver measurable outcomes, such as cost savings, reduced cycle times, and improved customer effort scores, through structured improvement programs

Support the implementation and optimization of CX technologies including CRM systems, analytics dashboards, and customer communication tools

Cross-Functional Liaison & Knowledge Management

Act as a liaison between the Customer Experience team and other business functions to drive collaboration and remove barriers

Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders

Coordinate cross-functional meetings, workshops, and initiatives, ensuring clear communication and follow-through on action items

Identify and resolve communication gaps or process inefficiencies across teams

Ensure consistent messaging and alignment across all stakeholders involved in CX initiatives

Design, implement, and maintain a centralized knowledge management system to capture and share organizational insights

Develop and curate documentation, SOPs, best practices, and process guides

Ensure knowledge assets are up-to-date, accessible, and aligned with organizational needs

Promote a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning across teams

Support change management efforts to drive adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working

About You

Basic Qualifications

Bachelors degree

5 years of experience in customer experience/success, program management, project management, strategy, or continuous improvement roles

Project and/or program management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Experienced in PowerPoint presentation decks and including presentation

Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities

Preferred

Experience with CX technologies such as CRM platforms or analytics dashboards

Demonstrated experience applying Lean and/or Six Sigma methodologies or similar (Green Belt or higher preferred)

Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification

Certification in one or more of the following: Customer Experience Management, Net Promoter System Associate, Design Thinking, Coaching, Change Management

Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry

Experience with the vaccines industry

Familiarity with customer experience metrics and measurement frameworks

Experience supporting digital transformation programs

Background in change management or organizational effectiveness

Why choose us?

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether its through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention andwellness programs and at least 14 weeks gender-neutral parental leave.

Work at the forefront of AI-driven research, smart manufacturing, and groundbreaking mRNA platforms that are redefining the future of immunology.

Help protect half a billion people every year, contributing to one of the largest global vaccination efforts in healthcare.

Develop your career with access to mentoring, international mobility programs, and opportunities to grow across four continents.

new_jobs.title: Research Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
1168054_RR00125488 Job ID: 1168054_RR00125488

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Project Manager.

The Project Manager for xenotransplant will support the Transplant Institute with work by managing the development, implementation and success of xenotransplant (living and brain dead decedent) initiatives. The Project Manager would be responsible for providing advanced range of coordination of these xenotransplant projects. The position would require assistance with the recruitment, enrollment, research data collection, study coordination activities and grant submissions. Performs study monitoring and serves as liaison with internal and external funding agencies. Ensures the accurate execution of research protocols in accordance with Good Clinical Practices, HIPPA, and required obligations to patient/subject, Principal Investigator (PI), Research Team and Sponsor. Interfaces directly with patients/subjects and PI in support of the clinical trials as applicable. Establishes liaisons with relevant parties at the Medical Center that may include: Research Coordinators, Research Pharmacists, Program Managers, Medical Technicians, Clinical Information Systems and Regulatory Services. Opportunity to assist in the initiation and management of research studies. Works under general direction. Places orders to be pended to appropriate provider as related to clinical trials only.

Job Responsibilities

ADMINISTRATIVE: Assemble and maintain project plans and documentation of project and/or program progress using standardized project management tools, in accordance with NYU Langone Health guidelines. Assists in the development and execution of stated goals and objectives for Transplant Institute. Assists in the development of new programs and projects as directed by Transplant Institute. Build and promote constructive working relationships with all stakeholders, using good judgement to provide objective recommendations. Able to balance diverse opinions from all levels of the organization while managing project results for the good of the organization. Recognizing routine problems and recommending suggestions, ideas, and solutions. Organizing, prioritizing, and expediting departmental workflows. Prepare and deliver presentations, analyses, and recommendations for process improvement. Gathers, enters, and/or updates data to maintain reports and databases, as appropriate. Perform ad hoc data analysis to support project planning as needed. Facilitate project team meetings by providing administrative support as needed, including setting meeting objectives/agendas, noting key decisions, and following up on action items. Use standardized project management tools to track key milestones, owners, and target completion dates.

STUDY REGULATIONS: Aware of study regulatory status and keep an up to date copy of regulatory documents. Assists with the informed consent process and ensure that the patient/subject fully understands what is required of them throughout the study. Follows through regularly with the patient/subjects reminding them of visits and compliance. May monitor any outward effects or issues regarding patient/subject safety and report this to the Principal Investigator, Physician and Nurse Practitioner.

DATA MANAGEMENT: Responsible for collecting and auditing patient information for the research project(s). This may include abstraction of data from the patient chart (e.g., laboratory or diagnostic test results, surgical/radiation treatments delivered, adverse drug reactions, etc.); abstraction of data for publications, or data collection from outside physicians offices. Audits and manages data from and into the database. Prepares forms and reports, compiles Recruitment Screens potential patients/subjects for eligibility to the study. This may include gathering information from the medical record, physician referral, advertisement and directly scheduling a visit to evaluate the patient/subject. Reviews all the elements of the screening process with the Principal Investigator that being: inclusion/exclusion criteria, completed informed consent, documentation of the event and the patient/subject willingness to participate in the study.

LABORATORY CLINICAL COMPETENCY: centrifuge, handling, storing and shipping of specimens. Clinical training and didactic competency tests may be required to perform basic procedures as part of position expectations. In house training and certification will be provided. Continuous Learning Position requires ongoing continuing education in all areas of research development (training programs are provided through the SOM). Promotes own professional growth and development in research role and maintains current expertise in area of practice. Maintains annual requirement of 10 CEUs in continuing research education; employee must demonstrate proof of ongoing research education. Serves as a resource to peers and works collaboratively with other disciplines within the area of expertise.

HUMAN SUBJECT RESEARCH/DECEDENT RESEARCH: As applicable oversee the submission of necessary documents required by the NYU Institutional Board (IRB), Research on Decedents Oversight Committee (RDOC), NYU Office of Clinical Trials and any other appropriate parties in order to obtain approval to conduct human subjects research (e.g., ensures the update and submission of necessary documents and/or forms to appropriate destination). Might prepare, audit and submit monthly enrollment statistics to the Office of Clinical Trials, and provides other information in timely manner, as necessary.

REPORTING AND ANALYSIS: Researches, compiles and consolidates data and conducts preliminary analysis to data collected for presentation to sponsoring and regulatory agencies. Provides reports to all necessary parties (e.g., the principal investigator, sponsoring agency, etc.) on the progress of the study as needed. Formulates, prepares database and generates preliminary measurement reports for review by PI. May complete assessments on study subjects/patients following protocol (with proper training); continues to follow-through with items and patients as part of the research study.

GRANTS: Prepares and submits grant applications and other grants related activities such as developing grants applications/proposals and fund-raising activities if applicable. Collects and organizes required paperwork for submission if applicable. Follow up and coordinates resolution of all issues. Reports to the sponsors to fund medical research in the division.

BUDGET: Assists in development of preliminary draft budgets in conjunction with Supervisor/Principal Investigator. Reviews sponsor-proposed budget for adequate coverage and recommend changes as appropriate. Assists in the preparation of funding reports to funding agencies and helps identify new potential sponsors/agents for trials and researches. Monitor budget throughout trial.

DECISION MAKING AND PROBLEM SOLVING: Combines and evaluates information and data to make decisions about relative importance of information and choosing the best solution to solve problems. Resolves complex situations and refers non-solved issues and questions with recommendation to supervisor.

COMMUNICATION/RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHERS: Cooperates, communicates and relates well to all levels of Medical Center. Listens carefully to others in-order to respond appropriately, answer questions or obtain needed information. Communicates ideas, problems, suggestions, and messages in a timely and effective manner. Maintains the confidentiality of all research information.

JUDGEMENT/DECISION-MAKING: Able to recognize problems as they occur; and through the application of appropriate policy/ procedure, determine and/or recommends the appropriate solution. Seeks guidance as necessary for the performance of duties, asks appropriate questions when in doubt and utilizes reference sources/materials to endure accuracy. Advises appropriate personnel of situations/problems requiring intervention or follow-up attention.

Additional Position Specific Responsibilities

May provide students with technical guidance and direction in the operation of various sample preparation techniques, extraction lines, and equipment as well as general laboratory practices and safety protocols. Ensures timely and accurate completion of research projects. Demonstrates knowledge of the organization's Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties. Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a Master's degree

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in business administration, health care administration, pharmacy or related field preferred. Experience with transplant and/or research operations preferred.

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.
