About The Department

Novo Nordisk’s Market Access and Public Affairs team engages diverse stakeholders across political and healthcare landscapes to forge solutions that drive patient access to innovative products. We strive to deliver the best possible outcomes for patients with diabetes, obesity, growth hormone deficiencies and rare bleeding disorders through mutual wins for both Novo Nordisk and our Market Access customers. Our passion for helping people live better lives and our award-winning product pipeline can only be as effective as our ability to provide information to healthcare providers, key stakeholders and policymakers. Our Market Access and Public Affairs professionals ensure that the latest therapies and products reach the people who need them most, by creating an environment where innovation and chronic disease management drive optimal health outcomes. Are you ready to realize your potential?

The Position

The Senior Alternative Models Program Management Manager is responsible for organizing and supporting the execution of specific strategic initiatives within the broader framework established by the Director of Program Management. This role is responsible for creating, managing, and executing project timelines and action plans for prioritized strategic initiatives. It also involves developing management tools and reporting templates, ensuring all initiatives are tracked and aligned with strategic objectives to enhance operational efficiency and facilitate effective collaboration across teams. Lastly, by supporting the facilitation of collaborations among teams and stakeholders, the Senior Program Management Manager supports the coordination necessary to design, launch, and scale our most critical initiatives.

Relationships

Reports to the Director of Alternative Models. Engages regularly with colleagues across Market Access and Public Affairs, as well as with internal stakeholders from Marketing & Patient Solutions, Executive Office / USO Strategy, Legal, Finance, and other relevant departments. Additionally, interacts closely with Alternative Model colleagues to ensure alignment and cohesive execution of initiatives

Essential Functions

Responsible for managing project timelines for specific strategic initiatives, ensuring all deliverables are met according to the established schedule

Monitor project deliverables closely, using project management tools to provide regular updates on progress to stakeholders

Proactively identify operational risks associated with project execution and develop strategies to address challenges before they impact timelines

Oversee the structured submission process for project proposals, ensuring clarity and consistency in documentation for efficient evaluation

Review incoming project proposals to assess their alignment with organizational strategy and objectives, evaluating feasibility and resource requirements

Collaborate with relevant stakeholders across departments to gather input and feedback on project proposals, facilitating prioritization discussions

Implement criteria for prioritizing projects based on strategic impact, urgency, and resource availability to ensure alignment with the overall project portfolio

Oversee the structured submission process for project proposals, ensuring clarity and consistency in documentation

Review incoming project proposals to assess alignment with organizational strategy and objectives, as well as feasibility and resource requirements

Engage with relevant stakeholders from various departments to gather input and feedback on project proposals and facilitate discussions for prioritization

Monitor intake metrics and trends, generating reports to provide insights to leadership on project proposal volume, approval rates, and resource allocation needs

Regularly review and refine the project intake process to enhance efficiency, minimize bottlenecks, and improve the quality of project submissions

Support the execution of strategic initiatives by coordinating activities and ensuring alignment with overall organizational objectives related to account management

Physical Requirements

10-15% overnight travel required.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred

A minimum of six (6) of experience in project management, project intake, or related roles, preferably within the healthcare or pharmaceutical sectors. An advanced degree may be substituted for 2 years of experience

Strong skills in managing processes and workflows, with proven ability to streamline project intake procedures

Excellent analytical skills to assess project proposals and make informed prioritization decisions

Ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels and facilitate collaboration across teams

Ability to work alongside account managers to support relationship building and ensure alignment with overall strategic goals

A keen eye for detail to ensure high-quality project proposal submissions and assessments

Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing responsibilities and evolving dynamics within the industry, reflecting a proactive approach to challenges and opportunities

The base compensation range for this position is $153,000 to $267,000. Base compensation is determined based on a number of factors. This position is also eligible for a company bonus based on individual and company performance. Novo Nordisk offers long-term incentive compensation and or company vehicles depending on the position's level or other company factors.

Employees are also eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs including medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; employee assistance program; tuition reimbursement program; and voluntary benefits such as group legal, critical illness, identity theft protection, pet insurance and auto/home insurance. new_jobs.description:
Build Our Future Together

The Senior Manager, Translational Medicine Program Management, provides program management support to cross-functional Translational Working Groups (spanning multiple development programs) and will also lead program agnostic initiatives. This role manages translational activities from preclinical research through post-marketing by driving the development and implementation of integrated Translational Medicine strategies, goals, timelines, and key deliverables.

When & Where

Primary Location: Tarrytown, NY

Discover Your Role

Provides scientific and/or operational direction to R&D functions for assigned Translational Medicine portfolio.

Drives Translational Working Groups by integrating key partners from Research, Preclinical, Translational Medicine (Precision Medicine, Clinical Imaging, Digital Biomarkers), Drug Safety and Pharmacometrics, Bioanalytical Sciences, Clinical Development, Program Operations, and other Global Development functions.

Develops and maintains integrated Translational Medicine program plans and timelines for strategy development and key program/study milestones, assay/platform/technology deliverables, interim/final data deliverables, and related decision points.

Supports development and execution of the Translational Medicine Strategy and its incorporation into clinical strategy, Integrated Development Plans, program/study plans in systems/tools, relevant governance discussions, and ensures cross-functional alignment and smooth transitions across pipeline stages. Manages relationships and communications across Translational Medicine, Research, Clinical Development, Program Management, and other cross-functional partners to improve alignment, execution, and visibility of deliverables.

May support cross-functional program-agnostic Translational Medicine initiatives, including process and technology development, and systems/tools enablement.

Interacts with senior leaders and may support executive-level communications, Translational Medicine Leadership reviews, and portfolio-level discussions.

Independently executes responsibilities. Contributes to program strategy goals and objectives. Influences the direction of the team.

This Role Requires

Have knowledge of Translational Medicine, Precision Medicine/translational sciences, biomarker and clinical outcome assessment strategies, biomarker/assay development, imaging, digital biomarkers, and sample management planning/logistics.

Have a high-level knowledge of drug discovery and development.

Proven track record in life sciences program management, including drug discovery and/or development programs.

Have excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills and the ability to effectively interact with all levels both within and outside the company to establish credibility with Subject Matter Experts on the project teams.

Have strong presentation, critical thinking, planning, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.

Actively promote constructive interactions among team members to address difficult situations.

Resolve and negotiate conflicts or problems with tact, diplomacy and composure.

Handle multiple projects and priorities with exceptional organizational and time management skills (both project and self).

Bachelors and/or masters degree with 8+ years, or a PhD with 7+ years, plus progressive project or program management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or a related industry. Experience supporting translational medicine and biomarker strategy, clinical development and/or Cross-functional portfolio/program planning and program management certification is preferred.

About The Company

Savi Gurus is a dynamic and rapidly expanding business and technology consulting firm headquartered in St. Louis. Renowned for its commitment to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional client service, Savi Gurus specializes in providing strategic consulting, process improvement, and technology integration services across various industries. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and continuous learning. With a focus on employee satisfaction, Savi Gurus offers competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive culture that values diversity and excellence. As a forward-thinking organization, it emphasizes the importance of staying ahead of technological trends and empowering its team members to excel in their careers.

About The Role

The Business Analyst Specialist at Savi Gurus plays a vital role in bridging the gap between business needs and technological solutions. This position is responsible for providing operational support, managing new business demands, and ensuring that project deliverables align with strategic organizational objectives. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in process analysis, requirements elicitation, and solution design, with particular expertise in Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and UiPath. The role involves engaging with key stakeholders to understand their requirements, translating business needs into detailed technical specifications, and supporting the delivery of automation projects that generate measurable business value. The Business Analyst Specialist acts as a point of escalation for project issues, fostering robust communication channels between business units and technical teams. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on innovative automation initiatives, contribute to process reengineering, and influence the organization’s digital transformation journey.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will hold a Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution, preferably in Information Technology, Business, or a related field, complemented by at least six years of progressive experience in business analysis or a related role. Expertise in UiPath and RPA is non-negotiable, with proven proficiency in process mapping tools such as Visio. Candidates should demonstrate strong analytical skills, experience with SQL and Excel for data analysis, and familiarity with testing methodologies and software. Knowledge of ITIL frameworks and IT product development methodologies is desirable. Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential, along with the ability to develop functional and non-functional requirements, use cases, and data/process flows. Candidates must be proactive, able to work independently, and excel in managing multiple priorities within a fast-paced environment. Additional preferred qualifications include experience in cost/benefit analysis, business case development, and client relationship management.

Responsibilities

The Business Analyst Specialist will be responsible for establishing and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders to facilitate open communication and clear expectations regarding project deliverables. They will collaborate with business partners to understand needs, prioritize requirements, and ensure alignment with strategic goals. Preparing comprehensive business cases, initiating large projects in partnership with Program Managers, and contributing to requirements elicitation and management are core duties. The role involves analyzing current processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and assisting with process reengineering initiatives. The analyst will document detailed requirements, develop prototypes and mock-ups, and employ business process modeling techniques to ensure clarity and traceability. Leading requirements management activities, providing coaching to junior analysts, and ensuring compliance with change management practices are also key responsibilities. Additionally, the specialist will support quality assurance testing, facilitate end-user acceptance testing, and monitor service level agreements to ensure project success. Regular status reporting, performance measurement, and lessons learned documentation will support continuous improvement efforts.

Benefits

Savi Gurus offers an attractive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional development of its employees. This includes a competitive salary structure, annual performance bonuses, and a matching retirement plan. Employees enjoy company-paid healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, and pharmacy benefits. The organization provides four weeks of paid time off, ten holidays, and a modest training budget to encourage ongoing learning and skill development. The company values work-life balance and fosters a positive work environment where team members are recognized for their contributions and encouraged to grow within the organization. Additional perks include a collaborative culture, opportunities for career advancement, and participation in innovative projects that make a tangible impact on clients and the organization.

Equal Opportunity

Savi Gurus is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse team enhances our ability to serve our clients effectively and innovate continuously. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We are dedicated to providing a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best.

PMP (Project Management Professional) or DAWIA Level II/III certification in Project Management or Logistics/Acquisition.
Hands-on experience developing and managing complex Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) / Integrated Government Schedules (IGS).
Deep operational understanding of the DoD Risk, Issue, and Opportunity Management Process

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

The Northrop Grumman CIDO Classified Solutions team is seeking a Principal Classified Cybersecurity Analyst
to support information systems lifecycle activities. The selected candidate will be required to work on-site, full-time at our Linthicum, MD location.

The responsibilities of this role will include but not be limited to the following:

Conduct system audits and continuous monitoring activities, covering all security controls, configurations, and operational processes to evaluate the security posture of the information systems.
Perform assessments of systems and networks within the networking environment or enclave and identify where those systems and networks deviate from acceptable configurations, enclave policy, or local policy.
Perform analyses to validate established security requirements and to recommend additional security requirements and safeguards.
Assist in the implementation of the required government policy, make recommendations on process tailoring, and participate in and document process activities.
Establish strict program control processes to ensure mitigation of risks and support the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) of systems; this will include process support, analysis, coordination, security certification testing, security documentation, investigations, software research, hardware introduction and release, emerging technology research, inspections, and periodic audits.
Support the formal Security Test and Evaluation (ST&E) required by each government accrediting authority through pre-test preparations, participation in the tests, analysis of the results, and preparation of required reports.
Document the results of A&A activities, and technical or coordination activities, and prepare the Risk Management Framework body of evidence.

Note: Due to the classified nature of the work being performed, this position does not offer any virtual or telecommute working options. Applicants are encouraged to apply only
if they are willing to work on-site, full-time at our Linthicum, MD campus.

Basic Qualifications

Master’s degree with 3 years of experience, or a Bachelor's degree with 5 years of experience, or an Associates degree with 7 years of experience; a High School Diploma/GED with 9 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a completed degree.
Candidates must meet the U.S. Government 8140 requirements for a Principal Cybersecurity Analyst– Security+ CE; the required certification must be maintained as a condition of continued employment.
Candidates must have a current U.S. Government Secret security clearance (at a minimum), to include a closed investigation date completed within the last 6 years OR must be enrolled in the U.S. Government Continuous Evaluation (CE) Program to be considered; the required security clearance must be maintained as a condition of continued employment.
Candidates must obtain a Special Access Programs (SAP/SAR) clearance before a start date can be established; maintaining this required clearance will be a condition of continued employment.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity or related field.
Knowledge of security tools such as ACAS, Nessus, Splunk, Trellix, and SCAP.
Knowledge of security frameworks and documentation such as NIST, JSIG, DAAG, SSPs, POA&Ms, and SCTMs.

We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. At Northrop Grumman, we are on the cutting edge of innovation. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us!

Primary Level Salary Range: $108,800.00 - $163,200.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

new_jobs.description:
About The Position

We’re seeking a Senior Project Manager
to support large, complex heavy civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (bus and rail), aviation (international airports), and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. Your main focus will be carrying assigned capital projects for a public infrastructure rebuild program from early scoping through design, agency approvals, construction, and final acceptance, and keeping street, water, sewer, and storm drain work aligned so the rebuilt systems come back online as one connected network.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position located in Los Angeles, CA.

Responsibilities
may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Oversee assigned capital projects from early scoping and capital planning through design, agency approvals, construction, and final acceptance and closeout.
Establish and hold the baseline for scope, cost, and schedule on each project, and report status, trends, and forecasts to program leadership.
Guide the consultants preparing feasibility studies, conditions assessments, and construction documents, and review their deliverables for completeness and conformance before they advance.
Align street, water, sewer, and storm drain work across related projects so the systems are planned, sequenced, and built as one connected network.
Sequence early-phase and construction activities with utility owners, regulatory and permitting agencies, and neighboring jurisdictions, and keep approvals and agreements from holding up the work.
Convene working sessions with the project team, agency staff, and the public, and document decisions and follow-up actions.
Analyze contractor requests for information, proposals, and change requests for merit, cost, and time impact, negotiate fair pricing and schedule relief, and draft the resulting contract modifications.
Oversee construction progress, confirm that completed work and payment requests match the contract documents, and support acceptance, turnover, and closeout.
Maintain project records that stand up to funding, reimbursement, and audit review, including cost and eligibility documentation for disaster-related funding.
Keep the client and project team aligned on what will be delivered, when, and at what cost, and work through issues and risks as they surface.

Attributes

Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.
Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.
Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Steady under shifting priorities and quick to work through issues as they surface.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Active professional license (Professional Engineer or licensed architect) or Certified Construction Manager (CCM) certification.
10+ years of project management experience, including managing projects through programming, design, permitting, construction, and closeout.
Track record of carrying projects end to end, from early scoping through design, agency approvals, construction, and final acceptance, as the single point of accountability for scope, cost, and schedule.
Experience reviewing and coordinating the preparation of feasibility studies, conditions assessments, and construction documents.
Experience aligning street, water, sewer, and storm drain work so related systems are delivered as one connected network.
Experience sequencing early-phase and construction activities with utility owners, regulatory and permitting agencies, and neighboring jurisdictions, and convening project team, agency, and public meetings.
Experience evaluating and negotiating contract changes and drafting the resulting modifications.
Experience with industry standard project / construction management software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project, Unifier, Kahua, etc.).
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in civil engineering, construction management, or architecture.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification (Project Management Institute).
15+ years of project management experience.
Experience delivering capital projects within a recovery program following a declared disaster.
Working knowledge of federal and state disaster funding eligibility and cost documentation requirements (e.g., FEMA Public Assistance, Cal OES).
Experience with large (>$500M), complex, heavy-civil infrastructure projects that include highways, roads, bridges, transit (including rail and bus), and/or airport projects.
Experience managing multiple concurrent capital projects.
Experience in an owner’s representative, program management, or construction management capacity for a city, county, or other public agency.
Working knowledge of California public works contracting, permitting, and environmental review requirements (e.g., CEQA).
Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, Oracle Cloud Analytics, or other dashboard KPI reporting software.
